title: “Absolutely the worst experience ”
review_text: Was excited to finally be in Singapore for a week. Arrived at the hotel and oddly they have you sign a separate form stating any stains or marks on towels and linens you will be charged for.  Opened the door to the room and yes it’s kinda shocking how small and cramped it is. The toilets in the shower which I might add the shower wall is etched glass so if somebody else is using the toilet you the person in the room can see. Also if they use the fan and light that lights up the entire room. Next to the bed is the sink, an I’m talking less then an arms length.  So within an arms length you can poop, shower, and shave and lay down because that’s all the room you have.  You can hear people peeing in the toilet from any adjacent room or showering or coughing for that matter. Back to the sheets, obviously I always check to make sure they are clean regardless but these had fluid stains and pretty much every linen in the place did. I took photos and brought it to the desk because I didn’t want to be charged. Apparently stains are just a common thing.  Night came and arrived back in the room and turned off the lights to find it pretty much seemed like daylight still. Right outside the window is a light pole with a gazillion watt light shining in. I took a pic inside the room and outside  of the street light. I brought that to the front desk and with a happy reply he said “that’s a street light issue, not a hotel issue so nothing we can do about it.” I asked if we could just get a refund and we would gladly leave but he said “when you signed into day you committed to the full stay.”  His idgas attitude spoke volumes.  We already spent our maximum budget for a hotel so we packed up and headed to the airport. I was not about to spend a week in a place you can sleep with workers who have zero care for customer care.  Bottom line, take your business elsewhere and you will probably be happier.  We did file a complaint with the Singapore hotel association and credit card company.

title: “It's a compact room, but it has everything you need.”
review_text: It was a two-week stay. The room is a bit small to open up a suitcase, but it has a floor-to-ceiling window that makes it feel open and not claustrophobic. The shower provides hot water and has good pressure, making it comfortable, and there's a water cooler on the floor, which is appreciated. Moreover, the refrigerator operates independently even when the card key for the power switch is removed, so it doesn't warm up while you are out. Also, when the front desk staff noticed my English level was not great, they spoke clearly and slowly, which was very helpful. There are takeout places at the nearest station just a short walk away, and there’s a coin laundry, a food court, a Seven-Eleven, and a supermarket very close to the hotel, making it extremely convenient. It’s quiet, probably because it’s a residential area, and personally, I found it very comfortable. However, there aren't power outlets near the bed, so a little creativity is needed, and while there are coffee cups, tea bags, and instant coffee in the room, there was no hot water (no kettle, and the floor server didn’t provide hot water). I should have asked the front desk, but it was hot and I thought it would be fine as it was.

We wanted to walk the Marina area to see the water, Merlion, trees (and light show), etc. and the Park Royal was just the place to start and end our adventure. The property was clean, had fabulous service, and was an easy drive to and from the airport...upscale, without feeling too flashy. Our room had some free water, a great layout with roomy bathroom, a solid view, comfortable bedding, effective a/c, and great t.v.  We left feeling we got a lot of value & a perfect hotel for our needs. One of our members used the fitness center & some had drinks in the lounge...all were pleased. We highly recommend the Park Royal.

title: “Acceptable”
review_text:
his weekend past, I booked a 3 day 2 night stay to celebrate my husband’s birthday and our 2 year anniversary. Amara Sanctuary touts itself as a “luxury resort” with “5 star rooms”; this is grossly misstated in every conceivable manner, and false advertising on your part. 

1. Your buildings and infrastructure are so poorly maintained, some parts are downright dangerous. The floorboards in the Dream Pool and kids pool are rotting and loose; roofing above Sky Pool was flapping about in the wind; flooring in Shutters have expanded and bowed up; we observed algae and mould on ceilings and walls. Your lifts were a stone’s throw away from breaking down, and carpets felt musty and crummy. 

2. Our room was definitely not cleaned well – windows were spotty and stained, the bathtub was grimy, and the toilet bowl was broken. We had to constantly request for simple things, e.g. adequate drinking mugs and toiletries. 

3. TV froze many times, and half the channels offered were unavailable.

4. Housekeeping and maintenance protocols are not well thought through. As a “sanctuary”, is it wise to have your gardeners using leaf blowers at 8am on Saturday? Understand it was raining heavily the night before, but surely there are quieter methods of cleaning up, without disrupting the “intimate setting designed to relax and rejuvenate (y)our senses”.

5. As an attempt at service recovery, your manager offered us complimentary breakfast at Shutters. We begrudgingly accepted, hoping we would be able to end our experience on a good note. However, the breakfast buffet was such a letdown – the food quality was nonexistent and service standards were nowhere near what a 5 star hotel should boast. Some examples: barely cooked soggy bacon; watery congee; rock hard pancakes; sausage with more filler than meat; coffee machines not calibrated, thereby causing mugs to overflow.

The only commendable part came from how hard the crew worked at trying to fix and mend what is clearly severely broken. T

title: “駅近で清潔なホテル”

出張で泊まりました。
(良かった点)
・ラベンダー駅から3分ほどの位置
→道も真っ直ぐなので分かり易い
・清潔感あり
→他の口コミの通りお部屋は狭いですが、ビジネス利用や1人で泊まる分には気にならないと思います
※大きなスーツケースで泊まる場合は少し大変かもしれません
・アメニティ(シャンプー、ボディソープ、コットンセット、歯ブラシ、スリッパ)と大きなバスタオル×2枚、ドライヤーが付いていて、連泊の場合はしっかり補充してくれる
※リンスや小さなタオル、くし、シェーバーはなし
・シャワーの温度や水圧、ドライヤーの風圧に問題なし
・ラベンダー駅近くにフードコートや飲食店、ホテルの向かいにはスーパーがあり、ホテルに朝食はないが食には困らない

(少し気になる点)
・シャワーとトイレが同じ空間にあり、仕切りがないので、シャワーがトイレの方まで侵出してしまう
→ベッドのある部屋とは仕切り戸がある＋シャワートイレ室に空調(乾燥)がまた別で付いてるので、ある程度時間を置けば乾くので個人的には問題なかったです
・少し値段が高め
→寝泊まりするには何の不自由もないホテルだが、逆に言うと朝食もなくそれだけと考えると少し割高
→比較的新しいのとシンガポールの物価を考えると致し方ないのかなとも思います

title: “Exceptional”
review_text: With two children, we stayed for one night in a room on the fourth floor with a balcony. The room was not small and very comfortable, and the minibar had snacks, tea, cola, and more. The balcony view was great, it was a sea view room, and we could see ships in the Strait of Malacca. The children were very happy swimming in the pool on the fourth floor. The hotel breakfast had good ingredients, a wide variety, and was very well-prepared, with attentive service from the restaurant staff. The hotel is a spacious garden with different levels of accommodation types and villas, several pools, and the architecture and landscaping have a strong Western influence, making it picturesque and suitable for vacationing. It’s a 10-minute walk from the MRT Yungbiou station, and less than 10 minutes downhill to Palawan Beach. It’s quieter compared to staying at Resorts World, and the location is slightly hidden but can be found using navigation. There is a YUE Chinese restaurant nearby. The meals inside the hotel are also very good, and hotel guests receive a small discount. Before checking in and after checking out, we stored our luggage at the front desk, went to enjoy the sledding and Universal Studios, and then came back to collect our luggage.

title: “Dirty room, with bugs, and damaged furniture”

Went here for my engagement and am very disappointed. Staff from the get go were rude and unfriendly. No one bothered to help with) bags and there were no welcomes or smiles.

The room itself was dirty, with stains on the walls and showers and chipped marble in the bathroom. There was hair in the sink that wasn't cleaned as well.

The shower drain didn't work, so when we showered it flooded into the restroom as well. Small flies also kept flying out of the drain.

The worst part was at night, we spotted what seemed to look like a bedbug in the room. A mosquito or other bugs are fine--you're surrounded by greenery, but this was unacceptable.

When we told the staff, instead of apologizing and trying to make it right, they offered to clean and send someone to declog the shower. In any other hotel, we would have been shown a new room, if not upgraded or comped. 

Instead we were given a room on the first floor (we were on the 4th). Luckily the drains worked and there were no signs of bedbugs.

For a hotel I spent nearly $400 a night for, and this being my engagement stay, this experience was horrible. Take your money elsewhere.

We celebrated our daughter’s first birthday at Amara Sanctuary, and it was an unforgettable experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and cared for. Their warmth, attentiveness, and genuine hospitality made the celebration even more special.

The resort itself is beautiful and serene making it a perfect blend of nature and luxury. Our room was comfortable, clean, and thoughtfully prepared, with everything we needed for a family stay. The peaceful surroundings also gave us a great chance to relax and enjoy some quality time together.

A huge thank you to the entire team at Amara Sanctuary for helping create such a meaningful memory for our family. We’ll definitely be back and we highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a special getaway, especially families with little ones.

title: “MOST HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE”
review_text:
We booked the Verandah Suite and was downgraded to a studio upon checked in. Hotel staff gave us complimentary breakfast as compensation, and we were fine. However, upon checking into the room, the air conditioning was not working. The room was warm and stuffy, maintenance staff came twice to check on the air conditioning, however, no one solved the problem. Maintenance staff wore boots into the room and walked all over the room leaving debris on the floor. The room downstairs was having a party with loud music, laughter, and screams.  Bed wasn't the best quality, woke up with a bad backache the next morning. Hotel staff were not friendly, called to mention the issue we faced in the room, but were met as if we were being inconsiderate. 

To be fair, I paid $675 for a night stay. I wasn't expecting such service and bad room quality.

I will not recommend anyone to stay in such a bad hotel. The experience was beyond horrible.

title: “Charming but Dated Hotel”
review_text:
Overall I give it a 5/10. Expect lush greenery and a chance for close encounters with the free-roaming peacocks so the main attraction would be outside of the rooms. 

The interiors however, fell short. Every thing seems to be falling apart starting from the waterfall feature at reception, to the malfunctioning toilet doors and lack of hot water in the room.  Also, the place is understaffed (although service was excellent from those few staff). 

I would also not recommend the breakfast at the on-premise restaurant called Shutters. For $28, I was served microwaved fish fingers and reheated chicken wings for the Nasi Lemak (which was supposedly a signature dish). 

Apart from that, the rooms are much larger than average and the compound is great for a stroll.  What this place needs is really a refurbishment to restore it back to its former glory.

title: “Meritus Club Marina such a great service for business traveler”
review_text:
first of all, the location is excellent. you can have rooms with the marina bay view. 
and it's next to Marina Square and across to Suntec Mall. 

Actually, i stay here with my niece, not in my business trip. But, this meritus club marina mandarin is best for business traveler. 

I booked one room in Meritus Club, it's on 20th  & 21st floor, the highest floor.  
since this rooms for business travelers, so they provide lounge called Meritus Club Lounge, in the 21st floor. So, you have private check in and check out facility. not as the normal guest. 

so much benefit they served us. we have room with the marina bay view. 
in the room they provide one handy smartphone that we can use it to explore singapore. 
and many benefit such as : 
- buffet breakfast, light sncaks, and daily evening cocktails in club lounge (but since i'm a moslem, and in the club they served non halal food, so we use Aquamarine halal restaurant, at lobby floor)
- complementary local telephone calls
- 24 hour wifi and internet
- minibar (and i loved so much the coffee maker one) 
- 2 hour usage meritus club boardroom each day (since i dont have any business friends to meet, so i didnt use this benefit yet)
- laundry 2 pieces each day
- shoe shine service
- late check out

all the staff very kind, especially the old man in the restaurant, he greeted us with friendly smile. and serve us best. 

all of the service so mean to us. 
hope we can stay here again someday. 
maybe in the business meeting, insha Allah.

title: “A resort that needs a makeover”
review_text:
I checked in at 4.15pm, and was still made to wait for about an hour before our 2 rooms were ready. This was disappointment considering that we were the only guests checking in on 1 Jan. I assume most other guests had already checked in on 31st December.  Sad to note that this resort thinks nothing of making guests wait.
The rooms were a huge disappointment.  The king-bedded room - phone was unplugged, and the bathroom had the foulest stench in the night.
The twin bedded room had obviously had the two beds pushed together, and had not been arranged back to its original design, thus leaving the bedside lamp totally unplugged as the console was in the middle. Glaring oversight by housekeeping!! There were no phones whatsoever in the room, and even after we reported this, no phones were provided. There was also no iron/iron board. The bathroom had mold in the shower stall, and such a strong smell of bleach. Toilet seats were not even closed... much the way men would leave it!!

title: “Memorial stay”
review_text:
Review for PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay

During my 3 days, 2 nights staycation at PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, I celebrated both my birthday and Christmas with a small in-room gathering, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional.

From the very beginning, we had multiple requests that required coordination across different hotel departments to properly organize and kick-start the occasion. Despite the heavy traffic and peak festive period, the service delivery was outstanding and exceeded all expectations.

The most impactful and memorable contribution came from the One Connect department. I would like to specially commend Ms. Linn, whose dedication, attentiveness, and consistent follow-ups ensured that every request was executed smoothly. Her ability to coordinate seamlessly despite the busy holiday season truly made a meaningful difference to our stay.

Zana from the One Connect team was also incredibly helpful, assisting with our daily requests and proactively following up on arrangements—often revisiting items that were initially not possible and finding ways to make them happen later. This level of care and persistence made us feel genuinely important and valued as guests.

In addition, Malini from One Connect stood out for her exceptional attention to detail and forward-thinking approach. She demonstrated the ability to anticipate guest needs rather than simply respond to requests. For example, when I requested a laundry bag, she thoughtfully prompted whether we would also require the laundry form, which we had initially overlooked. She confirmed this proactively instead of merely following instructions, and this level of initiative made me feel truly cared for and prioritized.

What stood out most was the seamless communication between guest requests, internal departments, and final execution. Everything was well-coordinated, reliable, and stress-free I had complete confidence in the team’s ability to deliver.

Even when there was a slight miscommunication regarding my birthday cake, the hotel handled it with grace and professionalism. The team followed up with a handwritten letter delivered to my room to express their apologies and appreciation, and later arranged for a replacement cake to be sent up at my own convenience. This thoughtful recovery turned a small hiccup into a truly memorable birthday-and-Christmas celebration.

The Concierge team also deserves special praise. They were friendly, proactive, and extremely easy to communicate with. As I had many bags and gifts, moving around Suntec and places like The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands would have been difficult but thanks to their efficient coordination, I could store my luggage safely and travel worry-free even after check-out. Their teamwork, readiness to assist, and clear communication made logistics effortless.

The Front Office team further elevated the experience. Check-in was smooth and flawless, handled by multiple hostesses who ensured everything was convenient and welcoming. Lydia was especially helpful in storing both my personal cake and the hotel’s complimentary cake, coordinating closely with One Connect to ensure everything was delivered at the correct timing. Her attention to detail made my birthday celebration effortless.

Casta stood out for her swift, decisive, and purposeful actions. Every step she took was efficient and intentional, reflecting true five-star service no wasted movements, no hiccups, just seamless execution. Her tone and professionalism clearly conveyed that our stay was important.

Lastly, Rosy assisted me with revalidating my room key and extending my late check-out. Her attention to detail, security awareness, and quick follow-ups were extremely impressive. She consistently checked, updated, and confirmed everything efficiently, which gave me great confidence in the hotel’s operational standards.

Overall, every department worked together to make my stay memorable from start to finish. PARKROYAL COLLECTION

I stayed in a Deluxe Room for two nights. Check-in took quite a while as there was queue. When I finally got to the deluxe room, I realised it didn’t have the separate bathtub and rainshower facilities that were supposed to be included. I tried calling the duty manager using the number provided in the room, but no one answered. I had to go back down to the lobby to clarify, and only then I was reassigned to a room with the correct facilities.
Breakfast was average and nothing particularly impressive. On the positive side, the staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay. The location is convenient, it is still walkable to RWS. There is also a shuttle bus available at specific times with drop-off at RWS.
Overall, I personally don’t feel this is a 5-star hotel, at most 4-star experience.

The staff checked on me to make sure I was doing okay and to let me know they are rushing the room cleaning but not to compromise cleanliness. Felt like the staff were just like my friends. Facilities were good, I would advise couples to book a room on the 4th floor with a balcony facing the sea. Room has high ceiling and was cosy with carpet floor. Just a corridor walk away from a small and pleasant infinity pool. View at the pool was blocked by trees though, I would advise the hotel to remove the trees so that every guest can enjoy the beautiful panoramic view from the infinity pool. Pool has to be booked in advance during this period, so when you check in, quickly book the pool! There is a ice dispenser on the 4th floor at outside the lift landing which is so convenient. Say goodbye to calling for room service just to ask for ice. There was also a shuttle bus service specially for hotel guests that would ferry guests from hotel lobby to vivo City drop off point and vice versa. I think this is really convenient for those who did not drive to the hotel. Overall, I enjoyed my stay at Amara Sanctuary. I would recommend!

title: “Upkeep & Maintenance ”
review_text:
We booked for the 1 BR Villa.

Upon check in, we were told to wait for the buggy to get us to the villa. We approached the security before and was informed that they only had 1 buggy so be continued waiting. After 15mins, we asked again and security asked us our villa number and he said that you could walk up it is nearby (would have appreciated if we were informed during the first contact). It was indeed nearby and the buggy passed us by on our way up and nope, no one bothered to ask us if they could give us a lift to our destination.

Room was exactly as per photo - only difference? It was run down. Lights in the pool not working. Lights around the villa - not all were functioning. Pool was old and had fallen leaves (ok can accept cuz there were alot of trees). Water temperature  in the pool was cold but it had a good depth. Doors got stuck and we could see some doors being plastered with tapes and some parts of the  pool disintegrating.

Room service menu was a dismay. Not much selection. But minibars are complimentary - limited selections but sufficient. Finally, wifi. We were informed that no pw required for wifi but the best part is we can’t even find the network. So i guess the router broker down? So, it’s consistent with overall poor maintenance.

We can see the potential glory of the space if it was maintained well. I mean with the price that Amara is charging we expected a better experience and service. However, based on all these, we will not be returning customers.

title: “5-star service, 3-star maintenance”
review_text:
The Good: The service is great, and the staff are really trying their best. All our requests were met promptly and with a smile. The resort is beautiful, and they've blended well the old colonial vibe with modern amenities. 

The Bad: The whole place seems like it needs better maintenance. The wooden flooring (both indoor and outdoor) is sinking, and may present a hazard if it gives way or causes someone to trip. The hot and cold controls for water at the sink in our room (Courtyard Suite with Jacuzzi) were REVERSED, which could have injured someone if they were trying to get cold water out of the sink and just stuck their hand in. The toilet in our room clogged on the first day. The white table on which our (delicious) dinner was served was dark with mould. The air conditioning in the restaurant leaked and dripped water on us. 

Given how hard the staff are working to provide great service for the guests, management ought to commit more resources to making this historic and beautiful hotel a real pleasure to stay in, and not a place where all the good points come with a "yes, but..."

title: “Great Service!”
review_text:
We had an absolutely wonderful staycation at Amara Sanctuary Sentosa — truly beyond what we expected, especially as a family with three young kids.

Right from the start, the team was incredibly thoughtful and proactive. When AIN found out it was just me with three little ones, she went above and beyond to surprise the kids with a teepee tent, balls, and stuffed toys in our room. It instantly made the stay magical for them and set the tone for the whole experience.

They were also very considerate in assigning us a ground-floor unit, which made moving around so much easier with young children — a small detail that meant a lot.

The entire staff was warm, friendly, and extremely accommodating throughout our stay. Special thanks to Bernice at reception and the shift manager as well — truly top-notch service all around.

The kids had an amazing time both in the hotel and exploring Sentosa, and I felt genuinely taken care of as a parent.

Highly recommend Amara Sanctuary Sentosa to families, especially those with young kids. We will definitely be back!

title: “poor maintenance and poor service ”
review_text:
My wife and I stayed there for her birthday, I had made a prior request for a cake as a nice gesture to my wife. (however no cakes were given, but I had already had a friend bring over a cake just in case, since some hotels just give a slice and we were expecting guests) 

We had 2 other families who were joining us for a couple of hours, mainly for the kids to have fun by the pool.  The pool's condition was very bad. Though it looked clean from a glance there were algae built ups on the floor of the pool. 
 
The series of events that followed due the poor maintenance of the pool was disastrous.

The first was my friend's daughter she slipped on the floor of the baby pool, however since she was wearing her life jacket it prevented her from hitting her head as she fell backwards. However her mother was not that lucky, within a few mins later she slipped (on a different spot) and hit her head on the floor. She had a very bad swelling, as we rushed to attend to her, my wife tried to call the hotel reception from the room phone. 

The hotel phone was not working! One of other friend's googled, Amara Sanctuary phone number to get hold of the reception. 

Yes hotel security and a few other staffs came to check on us eventually. But the fact that the hotel phone was not working was a serious matter. 

We later tried to order room service for the kids, and had requested for Ice for my friend's swelling.  The calls were not attended. We kept trying the numbers to connect to the concierge or reception, as no one was answering the in room service line.  Even the concierge and reception only attended the calls after 2 or 3 attempts 

Overall we are very disappointed with the service rendered to us during the stay. Yes the hotel is nice and spacious, but based on the lack of maintenance of the pool and poor service we will not return.

We chose this instead of a room with a bathtub, as we thought that we could just soak in the jacuzzi. When we arrived, the jacuzzi did not have any bubbles at all and was around room temperature or slightly colder. We thought maybe there was something wrong so we called the concierge for help and they sent an engineer to our room. When he arrived, he took a look at the jacuzzi and said that’s how it is supposed to be. We pointed out that only 1 out of 3 jets was working, and the only jet was not even bubbling and was super weak. We also mentioned that the water was not even warm. He said that that’s how it has always been and they have not done anything about it. Upon hearing this we were so disappointed because we paid extra just for the jacuzzi but what we got was not even considered a jacuzzi at all. In the end, we did not even utilise the jacuzzi because it was too cold to soak in and it was not bubbling at all. I feel for the price, they should at least make sure that the jacuzzi was working, and not just tell customers that it has always been like that and to just accept it.

title: “Disappointed”
review_text:
Booked 2 nights for birthday celebration.

When we arrived on for check in, there was one front desk personnel on the phone line and the duty manager was seated at the desk. We were then served by the duty manager after waiting and roaming around the lobby.

The duty manager did not smile and did not make us feel welcome. When we mentioned that we would like to check in, he said "Check in 3pm ah" and then proceed with the necessary paperwork. He did not inform politely that we can only check in at 3pm nor did he mentioned that he can proceed with the paperwork and will inform us once a room is available. His actions and tone of speech is akin to a local gangster or what we call ah-beng.

We were not offered the option of leaving our baggage with the front desk since our room were not ready. We were also not informed on the location and timing of our breakfast for the next 2 days. 

We made a lunch reservation for the Local Delights Weekend Buffet as the menu looks promising. However, both of us walked out of the restaurant feeling disappointed. The food range were very small (not as reflected on the menu found on your website) and the quality of the food were lacking. Oyster omelette was too starchy and lumpy, coconut milk was not available for pulut hitam, pad thai was not well seasoned and we avoided har kow as the skin was so thick. We paid closed to SGD 90 for 2 pax and it was not worth it at all given the reputation of your hotel.

After the 1st night, to our horror, the pillow on the bed was full of stains. We only came to notice it after the opening of the pillow casing came out loose. Utterly disgusting and gross out by your hotel hygiene. 


The disappointment was further enlarged during the night where the occupants next door were making such loud noise and disturbed our sleep. There were multiple guests, perhaps 10 pax or so, in the room next door.

title: “Nested in comfort & luxury”
review_text:
We were lured to visit after a fabulous time @ Pickering and expectations were met exceedingly. Loved the ease of checkin and the vast expanse of space. Being the former Marina Mandarin, there was a bit of the old timeless touches like the metallic centrepiece (I believe I took pictures of it as a teen!)and the glass capsule lifts.  The upgrades were tastefully added, bringing the lush greenery feel, the signature  bird’s nests skillfully weaved into cozy wooden structures & the ‘chirping’ birds littered along the corridors. The room was well-sized and other than the King bed, the bay window was my favourite for its scenery. It was wide enough for me to execute my Yoga poses!!

The Atrium Lounge was such a luxurious treat that we sat from lunch till high tea & had so many cocktails. Special mention to Head Mixologist, Michael Mendoza, for his delectable concoctions. Nothing fazed him as he entertained us with his bespoke long coolers, signature cocktails and new twists to classical drinks. No wonder we had some tipsy birds that stumbled back to our room. 

It’s without doubt that we will return with more friends after the official opening on May 17th.

title: “A shadow of its former self”
review_text:
I remember staying at Amara for a mate's wedding some time back before Covid. Alot has changed then - the facade looks run down with wood doors rotting, cracks showing in waterfall features, and moldy walls everywhere.

I get that Covid measures only opened up recently, and I was wiling to overlook the poor facade. But the staff didn't make things any easier. 

Besides the fact that they didn't tell me that a pre-requested king sized bed was not available until I reached my room; the checkin process was also extremely shoddy. There was no proper briefing on things like spa facilities, wifi passwords,  despite taking >10 min to check in each room. 

Turns out I had to call reception 2-3 times from the room before the calls were picked up and rudely answered. The safe and TV remote didn't work properly, the bathroom sink didn't drain properly, and the room wasn't even equipped with basic things like an umbrella (it rained during our stay) or laundry bag.

A request for a late check out was also not entertained.

I would say give this hotel a miss - there is plenty of competition these days.

Leading up to the stay, I've written in to request to be on the same floor as my bestriend as we had planned this together for her bday. Ms Amelia has noted the request and will try her best to accommodate.

At check-in, I think maybe the note was not passed on but I have highlighted to Ms Doris who tried her best to check and although the room is not ready (on the same floor), she expedited the housekeeping to clean the room. She also gave keys to the room and asked to head up in an hour. In the meantime, i waited at my friend's.

Due to unforeseen cir, my friend requested to change room as she preferred her original room (Lifestyle King) as there is a daybed compared to the one she was given free upgrade (to Mbs View) at Level 13 but the room is small.

Hence she was moved to the Lifestyle Room at Level 16. Because of this, I had went down to request (again) to be on the same floor (at this point, I have not been to my room yet as it was not ready.) however, the staff could not accommodate the request as there are no clean rooms at level 16 and I'd have to wait 3 hours if I want to change.

To my surprise, Ms Doris contacted me thru my mobile in an instant and asked if I would like to be on 16th floor. She managed to check and assigned the room just next to my friend's! 

I am very pleased with her efforts as she had gone up to level 16 to pass the room keys herself. I must thank Ms Doris for going the extra mile and exceeding expectations.

Thank you Ms Doris! 

We will definitely return again. Stay safe :)

review_text:
TL;DR
Aged furnishings in the rooms are not maintained well. Breakfast buffet was mediocre at best. Not worth the price we paid; I would not expect this of a 5-star hotel.

Stayed in a deluxe king room. The room as a whole was generally clean. But the infrastructure was poorly maintained. The bathroom was the worst part.

The shower holder was broken.
The shower door also did not close fully, which meant that water escaped and flooded the main area of the bathroom.
Worse, the water did not flow into the drain, but pooled next to the toilet bowl due to how the tiles were sloped.
The smooth marble bathroom tiles were extremely slippery when wet.

The sink was built on top of a wooden frame, which was mouldy, chipped, and peeling; splinters of wood jutted out.

The drainage mechanism in the bath tub was not working.

The air conditioner could not be controlled, regardless of what was set on the interface.

The cups in the mini pantry could not be removed from the drawer - they were too thick to fit through the gap of the drawer. We couldn't make tea/coffee in the room.

Breakfast buffet was generic and bland. The Asian food on offer was (surprisingly) bad, especially the hot noodle station. If breakfast is not included in your deal, don't bother paying for it.

title: “Great place to stay even with young children”
review_text:
We stayed for a week as a special treat during our last leg of holiday. The first impression of this hotel was great, though the check-in process can be a bit confusing (many people sitting at the lobby, so not sure if they were queueing to check-in or not). 

Our check-in went smoothly and we even received a special cake for spending our wedding anniversary with M Hotel. 

The room is spacious with amenities just as shown in the pictures.  We love the fact that the room has separate shower and bathtub. Our kids love the bathtub so much. 

The housekeeping is very courteous and helpful. We always came back with a neat and fresh bedroom everytime we went out. When we asked for additional service, such as extra tea, coffee or even towel, their service is 5 stars. 

Their concierge is also very helpful, particularly Ruben. He is a superstar! He helped us with storing our food in their fridge and freezer. He also helped us to order our airport transport as we have so many baggages. 

The location of the hotel is very strategic. Though it is located at the heart of CBD, the access is great, from buses to MRT. We also can easily get food as there are lots of eatery available nearby which open until past midnight.

Thank you Hotel M for making our trip in Singapore so memorable.

title: “Pick another hotel. This was so bad. ”
review_text:
Had a terrible experience here. 
I booked a staycation for my birthday for myself and 2 friends at your Sentosa branch. We paid extra to ensure accommodation for 3. 

Feedback:

1. When we got there, we were given 2 twin beds that were only good for two. I’m not sure what the expectation of the staff was with giving us this when none of us were couples. All friends. We had to specially request for an extra bed, which they said would be brought right up at 4PM. We had plans for 5PM but since the staff said they were right on it, we decided to wait. By 630PM the bed still hadn’t arrived yet. We missed the appointment and ended up having to call At least 4 more times to follow up to get the already paid for bed. 

2. Staff came with a bed left without giving the third bed pillows. So we had to call again and wait again to get pillows. 

3. After waiting again, the staff came with pillows and left immediately. The pillows were given without pillow cases. We were so confused. So we called yet AGAIN to ask for the pillow cases. Staff arrived a while after without pillow cases and told us sorry, there are no more pillow cases because it’s a full house. At this point, we’re terribly confused. We are sympathetic to an establishment being full and possibly being short staffed, but no pillow cases? Really?  And the reason is because it is a full house? So other guests are prioritised? Or managing a full house comes at the expense of paying guests? We couldn’t understand how this was an acceptable excuse. Why would we even bother booking a hotel for this?

Not used to talking to staff at least 8 times within a few hours of check in to get what we believe are basic things. No one even bothered to apologise or explain. Strong  mismatch between Amara experience and industry standards.

title: “That's wonderful!”
review_text: The renovated place is beautiful everywhere you look! The room has a sofa and a table, allowing us to have meals in the room. The toilet can smell if the lid is not closed, but it's not bothersome. There is a separate shower booth apart from the bathtub. The drinks in the refrigerator are paid, but there was a free coffee machine with TWG tea bags. We stayed for several nights and only requested towel exchange and tea replenishment without room cleaning. There are main amenities, towels, and bathrobes available. I didn't like the scent of the shampoos provided, so I used the ones I brought with me. There is a walking route from the hotel to Marina Bay. We used an ez link card (a card like Suica, which can be issued at stations with people and topped up with a credit card at Seven-Eleven or machines before the ticket gates) to travel by MRT and bus. The main roads in Singapore do not have well-established pedestrian routes, and it can be confusing for beginners, so we took the underground passages. The hotel connects to a mall, so we had meals there or brought them back to our room. We used the poolside restaurant (more like a café), and the staff was nice, and the burgers were delicious! title: “Electricity shutdown at 11pm for up to 6 hours??”
review_text:
During check-in at the counter lobby, I was truly surprised to be informed (after I just made full payment, and not before??) that there will be an electricity shutdown for maintenance at 11pm the next day, for up to 6 hours. I asked if they meant 11am (coz that would made more sense), but nope.. in fact the receptionist seemed pretty pleased that it would be 11pm. 

Whilst there was a torch light in the room, there is no way one can tell when that torch light battery would just run out. It was absolutely pitch black, complete silence, hot coz airconds were out, and I could hear people doing whatever maintenance work they were doing at 2-3am outside the room. 

Definitely not the experience I was expecting from a hotel in Singapore. Definitely not the experience any of my Singapore colleagues would expect in fact.

Time planning for maintenance work could have been better. Not at midnight whilst customers are trying to get some rest?? And if absolutely necessary, how about inform in advance or reduce the room price or refund for the inconvenience?? 

Receptionist could have been more sympathetic, and less grinning whilst answering my obviously concerned questions would have been appreciated. 

Location is fine. Breakfast was fine. Room design and furnitures are dated. 

Shower was terrible.. water pressure was low. The morning after the electricity shutdown - there was no hot water and the pressure was even worse.

title: “Exceptional Service”
review_text:
We had a truly memorable staycation at the Amara Sanctuary Resort Hotel. I would like to extend my deepest appreciation to Ms. Putri at the front office for her outstanding service. We were celebrating Mother's Day, and although everything was lovely, what truly stood out was Ms. Putri’s thoughtfulness and dedication.

My daughter was unexpectedly called back to work at the hospital and had to leave by 5am, and was going to miss the paid breakfast buffet. I asked if it might be possible to have something packed for her, after many "No", I mastered the courage to ask Ms. Putri during check in as it meant alot to me to ensure that my daughter had something to eat before going to work at 5am. Ms. Putri was very kind and understanding, she went above and beyond to assist me to put in the request. She personally liaised with the restaurant and kitchen team to prepare a takeaway breakfast, which included bread, fruits, and yogurt—all thoughtfully packed in a biodegradable box. We really appreciate the restaurant and kitchen effort in making it happen even though they were very busy on Mother's Day. 

It was a simple yet incredibly meaningful gesture that showed genuine care and attention. Thanks to Ms. Putri, and the restaurant/kitchen staffs that  my daughter was able to leave for work at 5am with a smile and a full stomach. This kind of service makes all the difference, and truly made Amara Sanctuary special. Thank you all for making our stay so special.

title: “入住六晚覺得很不錯！”
review_text:
從機場到飯店很方便，中途需要轉乘，不過是同一條線很方便！
飯店附近吃東西和買東西很方便，有麵包店、麥當勞、漢堡王、蜜雪冰城、一點點、瑞幸咖啡還有國營的超市，再走遠一點有開很晚的店可以吃晚餐+宵夜。
搭電梯時需要房卡才能按樓層，出電梯後有飲水機，有熱水、常溫水和冰水可以飲用，房間需要打掃可以掛牌子，房間有一個萬國插座，一個新加坡插座（用來插吹風機），如果需要同時使用兩個插座，可以帶一個萬國插座，插座不在床頭邊，廁所裡面沒有插座。
浴室裡面有提供沐浴乳、洗髮精、牙刷牙膏和浴帽，衣架有四個，入住時馬桶附近有小積水，不過後來就沒有了，廁所開大電燈和抽風是一起，比較吵一點，另外有一個小燈光可以開。
窗簾沒有辦法完全擋住陽光，冷氣風會吹動窗簾，感覺某個角度可能外面可以看進來（自己猜測）。
房間的空間較小，走道空間只能一個人，有一個小小的冰箱，飲料大概可以冰2-3杯。
櫃檯人員我遇到的都不會說中文，不過人都很好，進出都會給你一個溫暖的微笑😊還會提醒不能抽煙和帶榴槤唷！

title: “Great stay at Beverly Hotels Elements! ”
review_text:
Stayed from Oct 3-6. Paid around PHP7,000+ per night. Will definitely stay here again! 

Room is new & pristine! Loved it! Hallways smell nice. Room has shelves, safe, and mini ref. No table and chairs. Hotel provides toilet paper, towels, body wash, shampoo, sanitary bags, shower caps, & dental kits. No soap bars just the body wash. 

Room is small if you have luggages. Carry-on luggage (bearable enough to move around), Big luggage (will be a challenge). The shower and toilet area has no divider so water splashes a bit everywhere but floor dries up quickly. There is a bidet!!! 

Location is great! A 5 min. walk from Lavender station (which connects easily to other train lines). Lots of eateries (old chang kee, local hawker, 7eleven, toast box, mcdonalds, burger king, food stalls/complex) around. Fairprice supermarket is just across the hotel. 

Read other reviews about the AC. It's not that noisy. More like a white noise. Soft hum. For us, it was normal. 

Staff answered our queries and accommodated our requests swiftly! Thank you IK for all your help! You're very nice & charming! The hotel required a SGD50 security deposit which was returned after our stay.

title: “Below Expectations with Poor Check-in Experience”
review_text:
Stayed for a night at the M Hotel in celebration of my anniversary with my boyfriend. Our first impressions were not great; we booked a Deluxe room and the lady staff at the reception confirmed our double bed upon checking in. However, we were given a room with three single beds. Called reception immediately to ask if there's been a mistake but was told reception would call us back because they are 'busy'... after 20 mins of waiting, we made another call and had to re-explain the entire situation (during which we were put on hold several times whilst the staff checked). We were then told that 'systems were down' and they couldn't check the status of any rooms until 4 or 5pm, and even then, the changing of rooms would be subject to availability.

We wasted a good hour going back and forth, before deciding to just leave as none of the staff seemed to be able to sort our room out promptly. Came back later in the night and luckily, finally got our room (the staff actually tried to convince us again if we'll like to stay in our original given room, which we declined).

Room was fine and everything worked well, but some areas were evidently dusty, such as above the alarm clock and the snacks bar. Wasn't impressive. Did not try any of the other amenities or needed anything else throughout our stay.

Wasn't a completely bad stay but M Hotel could certainly do better, especially after its high ratings. Our holiday is short and the check in was a huge time waster and left a poor taste in our mouths. Hopefully M Hotel will improve in the future.

title: “Beautiful Lobby, Dirty Rooms, Terrible Staff ”
review_text:
Lobby has a magnificent view but the cleanliness of the room was terrible - Thick layers of dust could be seen from the aircon vent, ceiling of shower area was black and mouldy, tiles were yellow. The least the hotel could do was to paint over the walls. 

WORST of all was staff - They threw away our contact lens case and the duty manager managed the situation poorly. He was practically like, "Okay, I'll solve the issue by giving you a bottle caps. The problem is solved now, what else do you want?" 

Luggage took 45 minutes to be brought up to the room and a similar experience for check-out too. The front door lobby staff/manager (guy with a blazer) was rude and unclear with instructions for parking; scolding the bellboy for leaving him alone at the front door (bellboy was tasked to collect luggage from our room) in Malay, thinking that we do not understand Malay. The front door lobby manager literally said this in Malay, "Why? The guests cannot wait is it?" 

I WILL NEVER STAY IN ANY PARKROYAL OR PAN PACIFIC HOTELS ANYMORE!

title: “Looks promising but does not deliver ”
review_text: A lovely resort that is unfortunately ruined by mismanagement. Resort itself is absolutely lovely but the experience unfortunately takes away from looks and feel of the resort. We had booked a room with access to a pool. At check in we had to wait 45 minutes for the room to prepared (even though we had arrived after 3pm) - in itself this is not a problem, but we were not offered any apologies or refreshments or taken to the pool while we waited, the staff stood around on their phones and eventually we had to check in.  When we did get invited to the room the staff were still cleaning (not the housekeepers fault) but then the housekeeper and the staff member who brought us started to argue and then they phoned reception again and started to argue (presumably about letting us in the room without it being finished). However, we then had a note in the room saying that access to the pool (the only selling point of the room) was not available due to a private event. This was not mentioned on the website or checkin and no compensation or any sort of alternative was offered.  Finally a member of staff appeared to apologise, but this should be standard front of house training rather than us waiting over an hour for something to apologise for this mess. We asked for an upgrade that was accommodated to a room with jacuzzi access but I doubt any sort of upgrade would have been offered if we had not asked. We had been given absolutely no information about where to get breakfast, or any facilities (I.e the gym or spa - even the location of those things) in the one night we were there. In sum, they need to train their staff to a much higher standard in order to deserve any sort of five star rating - I have received kindness, warmth and basic information about hotel facilities in most places I have ever stayed in, but you would expect this as a given in a five star resort. The service we received was akin to a two star but with a massive price tag. I also left an item of clothing in the room and phoned for them to check for it while I was still in Singapore so I could pick it up.  I received no call back and I eventually phoned to confirm they had not found it after I had flown back to HK (as I assumed they didn’t have it) and I was told they did have it.. they just had not phoned to tell me. I have been asked to pay for shipping (fine) but also a 20% surcharge (again fine) but given I had asked them to let me know asap so I could pick it up while I was still in the country you would expect for them to perhaps waive the surcharge or at least apologise that they didn’t contact me (no apology). I have not received my item of clothing I would be shocked if they have actually posted it at this point given the level of mismanagement.  If you are prepared to stay in a five star resort in Sentosa, save yourself and go elsewhere.

title: “Perfect for a 4-star hotel”
review_text:
The newly opened hotel has everything one would want in a hotel — from super tidy rooms to short-distant metro stations, to grocery stores and food spots that are open past midnight.

You can find FairPrice right opposite to the hotel and Seven-11 (opened 24/7) right opposite to FairPrice. You can also find plenty of food spots just a few blocks away, including McDonald’s, Burger King, and Subway, which are all halal friendly.

The major tourist spots are not too far from the hotel and it is easy to get around. Lavendar MRT Station is at 3 mins walk. Bendemeer MRT Station is at 6 mins walk.

The hotel is super tidy and always smells nice. The staff is friendly and always helpful. Special shoutout to Clarice for always being there and helping me with the know-how of the city!

Although you may find the rooms quite small with no good views out the window, they are all pretty well maintained as well.

Regarding the noticeable improvements that the hotel has room for:

The rooms are a bit pricey and pretty small. There are no side tables, no desks or chairs. So you only get to eat food and work from the beds provided.

The TVs only have a few channels, but having support for YouTube had me covered with entertainment for the most part.

The views right outside the windows are not very attractive but I liked that the large windows let the sunlight in.

Overall, my stay at Beverly Hotel Elements has been amazing and I’d definitely stay there again with no second thought.

P.S. If anyone can help and tell me the name of the scent they use in their corridors and reception, I’d be very thankful. :)

title: “깨끗하고 혼자 머물기 적합한 가성비 좋은 호텔”
review_text:
호텔 스탭 Christine 은 무척 친절하며 고객의 요청에 최선을 다해 응답합니다. 그녀가 호텔 프런트에 머물 때면 밝은 미소와 인사를 나누며 하루를 더욱 기분좋게 시작할 수 있었습니다. 그녀에게 감사를 전합니다. 

호텔 청소는 매일 완벽했습니다. 매번 침구는 잘 정리되어 있었고 물건들은 제자리로 돌아갑니다. (청소 시간이 미리 안내된다면 더욱 좋을 것입니다.) 

다만 천장 높은 곳에 위치한 에어컨은 필터 청소가 쉽지 않은지 온도를 조금만 올려도 좋지 않은 냄새가 나 계속 최저 온도를 유지해야 했던 점은 아쉽습니다. 

호텔 근처엔 여러 푸드코트와 호커센터가 있습니다. 번화가와 떨어져있어 밤에 조용하지만 아라빅 거리와 부기스 거리는 버스로도 쉽게 오갈 수 있어 편리합니다. 

무엇보다 1인 싱글 침대 룸을 제공하고 있어 숙소에서 간단히 잠과 휴식만을 원하는 1인 여행자에게는 좋은 선택입니다.

review_text:

部屋について:部屋の大きさは写真で見るより小さく、2人分のスーツケースを広げる事は出来ませんでした。でも長時間部屋にいる訳でもなかったので、個人的にはさほど狭さは気になりませんでした。

またプラグを持って行ってなく、部屋にも置かれてなかったのですが、フロントに言ったら借りることができました。
シャンプー(リンスなし)、ボディーソープ、ドライヤー、タオル(大きいバスタオルのみ。体洗う用の小さいタオルはなし)歯ブラシ、シャワーキャップは部屋に置かれてました。パジャマは事前にメールで問い合わせてないとの事だったので、持参しました。

title: “Excellent for solo or business traveller 😊”
review_text:
This is an excellent hotel for a solo traveller or a business traveller.


#1 The location. The hotels surrounding MBS area are so expensive. I'm in Singapore for a 2 day conference and i know i won't be staying in the room so i wasn't willing to shed lots of money on accomodation. 

The area of Kallang/Lavender was one of the closest to MBS and the airport. The conference i am attending was happening in the sands convention and it was so easy to go to and from the hotel to MBS. Moreover, after the convention i also have to catch my flight  going back to the Philippines. The location was perfect and i was in the airport in 20-30 mins via taxi from the hotel. I also checked out early on my last day and the hotel held onto my baggage while i went to the conference. 

#2 the hotel was new. I was excited to come across this hotel since it just opened late 2022. So i am absolutely positive that the facilities are new and clean (hope they can maintain it).

#3 Price. Since i won't be staying in the hotel and will be out and about during my stay. I decided to set a budget and this hotel perfectly fit that budget. 

#4 Reviews. There were lots of positive reviews online towards the hotel and that is a plus for me. I really do my research and read reviews of hotels i intend to stay into so i get an idea what to expect when i arrive and stay in a particular hotel. 

#5 Food. It was close to a lot of restaurants and cafe. I don't like to worry about food source when travelling. There were convenience stores and grocery in the area as well. 

I love this hotel and was really happy about my stay. Though it isn't perfect, it was perfect for what i require during my stay. 

Cons to think about:
1. if you are travelling with your family with more than 4-5 people. don't stay here because the rooms are small. You cannot even leave a luggage open and no luggage space also. If you are travelling with family and you still intend to stay here, consider getting an extra room. Room i staye

title: “Anniversary Stay”
review_text:
Club Lounge
Pros: 
Check in was pleasant, served by Kate. Kate gave a late check out till 1pm, which was great. There were hiccups initially, wrong room type was given when I entered the room. I went back down to the reception, Kate immediately rectified the issue. She mentioned that room was not ready. I didn't mind waiting since I came early. I went to check out the lounge. Ariane & Alya (pardon me if i misspelled your names ladies) were ready with their biggest smile to welcome me. When I mentioned my Urban suite room is not ready, Ariane expedite it at her own accord & passed me my room card. I was impressed. Alya showed me to my seat & shared with me the spread they have and timing infos for breakfast afternoon tea & evening cocktail. When I requested for watermelon juice, Alya checked if there was and happy to say it will be served. Bala served my drink with friendliness and professionalism. When it was time for me to leave (apparently I was the only 1 left in the lounge), the lounge staff bade me gdbye. Ariane even asked if I need to be accompanied to my room. I was really pampered there and I think the service was marvellous.
Please convey my thank you and kudos to these staff mentioned.

Cons:
I decided to drop by to the lounge again abit before afternoon tea. I went with my husband this time round, telling him the great service I experienced a few hours ago. Unfortunately, service was different from my previous visit.
There was a small-sized lady staff at the counter. I believe she was a Filipino. She was busy talking on her handphone and didn't stop to welcome us in. We chose our own seats. We were waiting to be asked what drinks we would like but no one came to us. The staff didn't come over and was still on her handphone. We hang awhile for 10 minutes before leaving. We walked past the counter but we still were not acknowledged. Total disappointment.

Rooms
Pros:
Our Urban Suite Room 2020 was amazing. Size was good, view was fantastic. The complimentary snacks from the picnic basket was awesome. Though Marina Parkroyal did not set up any anniversary surprise for us (which I mentioned to Rachel), the picnic snack was suffice.

Cons:
I just came back to my room that afternoon and was changing. I heard the doorbell rang a few times. I was busy getting dressed when I heard the door opened. I was lucky I was in a suite, hence I wasn't dressing up openly and was in my bedroom. By the time I walked in with my shawl half done around my head to the living room, 2 staff were walking in right in the middle of the living room. I was so shocked. At least, give it 'hello' and I could have replied to give me a minute. Two ladies I believe were Vietnamese or Burmese (Myanmar). They asked if I needed anything. I just checked in like 3 hrs ago. I told them not to enter if I didn't open the door. I was very frustrated with their service & attitude.
I have been to many good chain hotels around the world and this was the first time I encountered such an experience. Usual practice for housekeeping staff will ring the bell and if there is no answer, they will hang a note outside the room informing guests of their names & that they came by for housekeeping service. If guests need their service, we can always give housekeeping a ring.  Even without the Do Not Disturb sign on, housekeeping staff usually don't go in, especially when guests just checked in. I put on the sign for DND all the way during my stay after that fateful incident.

If Marina Parkroyal (which is a good brand of hotel), does not or has not adopt such a practice, please start soon. 
I felt very angry and frustrated that my privacy in that suite was invaded. 

I hope the hotel manager, Mr Phil Smith, can look into this serious matter.
I would have given this property 101% awesomeness if not for these issues mentioned. I am sure my feedback will be reviewed for training and better quality of staff. 
Thank you.

review_text:
I stayed with my extended family, we got the One Bedroom Villa for my family and a couple more rooms for the rest. The rooms are newly renovated. The Villa was showing its age, the toilet, however, looked new. The rest of the facilities looked like they were not taken care of. For sure they were badly hit by the pandemic that caused all of these. I just hope now that Singapore is reopening they can recover well and fast and take care of the resort. Would be a shame to let it go worse. 

Service? I’d say the staff underperformed. Especially for a 5-star resort in Sentosa. But I understand that this may also be because they’re understaffed and struggling. 

Will I stay again? The privacy that the villa provided us was worth it. We had a pool all to ourselves and many more.  There’s not a lot of such facilities here in Singapore. So Amara will still be on my list.

They also gave me a complimentary mousse cake as I was doing a birthday staycation. That was very nice of them! 

There is shuttle bus to and fro the hotel so it's convenient to get to the hotel. 
Otherwise, it's a short walk to the busstop along the main road or Imbiah monorail train stop. 
It's also a short walk to the palawan beach so it's nice to walk around.

Breakfast buffet was nice and filling.

Overall, a great stay and hope to stay longer next time!

title: “A Property that is Struggling”
review_text: Was our first time in Amara, and we were excited to try the Couple Suite with direct access to pool for romantic escape from the kids. We arrived at the property and told we were upgraded to a "Family Room." When we told them we didn't want the upgrade, and were happy with the room we booked, they told us that the room is not available, and that we actually don't have much of a choice on the room. They could have communicated this earlier and we could have had the option of cancelling our booking and going somewhere else -- so we felt hijacked from the get-go. The same receptionist (and there were only 2 receptions on desk) who checked us in was the same person who drove the buggy to our room, which tipped us off that the property is probably severely understaffed.  We tried calling in room service, and the line kept on ringing, no response on the other end. After 45 minutes of trying, we finally decided to walk up to the restaurant. Again, looked understaffed, which explained the lack of response. Thankfully, we were able to put our orders in, and it arrived within 45 minutes. The next morning, we were excited to get some pool time thinking that might save the experience. We reached the pool and it was a mess -- empty champagne bottle and flutes, crumpled tissue papers, and masks strewn in the lounge area, no clean towels, no attendant. The wood planks by the pool were not even, with some coming loose, and we could clearly rusty nails. It didn't look and feel safe and clean. We tidied up a corner for ourselves, and in the 2 hours we were baking in the sun, did not see a single attendant. Was disappointed with the whole experience. The property felt run down and ill-maintained, and the staff felt overworked.  Felt so sorry for the staff, and was a horrible experience at a 5-star price point.

title: “今まで宿泊したホテルで1番でした！またぜひ泊まりたいです！”
review_text:
人生初のシンガポール旅行だったのですが、素敵なホテルのおかげでとても満足のいく旅行になりました！
ハーバービュー側でツインベッドのお部屋に3泊4日での宿泊しました。お部屋も広くとても綺麗で設備も揃ってて快適に過ごせました。

お部屋に関するリクエストをお願いしたのですが、お部屋の予約をしたのが宿泊日の1週間前を切っていたので希望に沿っていなくても仕方ないと思っていました。しかしチェックインしてみると希望通りのお部屋にしてくださっていてお部屋からの景色も含めとても素敵でした！すごく嬉しかったです！

備え付けのバスローブはふわふわで着心地◎
水回り設備は水道水とは別に飲料水用の蛇口があるので元々準備してくださっているお水が無くなっても継ぎ足せて安心です。
アメニティも揃っており不自由はないかと思います。
バスルームはコンパクトなガラス張りのシャワーブースの隣にお手洗いを挟んでバスタブがあります。
クローゼット横には冷蔵庫とお茶のアメニティ類があります。お茶はTWGのものでお土産購入の参考にできました◎
周辺はホテルが集まっており、マリーナスクエア直結で立地的にもとても便利です。
次またシンガポールに来る機会があれば是非もう一度こちらのホテルに宿泊したいです。

title: “Nice Villa ”
review_text:
I stayed at Villa 01 for 2 nights. At the first night, the mosquitoes were terrifying. But they somehow disappeared the next evening.

The villa is very spacious, consist of one bedroom with bathroom in it and another room for living room with a toilet in it. Plunge pool is big enough to plunge but too small to swim. Nothing to complain about the pool.

The open air bathub is something to remember. It's really nice. Free minibar with 2 cans of tiger beer is also very thoughtful as it's not too convenient to find 7 eleven near the hotel. Will definitely come back in the future.

Secondly, the food options do not cater to a wide range of choices and I even found ants in my waffles!!
Thirdly, they are not flexible with accommodating late check ins  or  late check outs (had to pay an entire day's worth of room rent for checking in at 6 am in the morning).

title: “Outside is not inside ”
review_text:
The Good: Hotel is 5 mins walk to MRT, 20 mins walk to Maxwell Hawker and Chinatown. Bus stops are just across the streets. McDonald's is just 5 mins of easy walking. Hotel lobby is beautiful and bright. I booked for 2 people per room, but Agoda somehow had us just 1 person and docked one breakfast. Luckily, reception gave us one complimentary breakfast.Breakfast is good not excellent. 
Not so good: We booked 2 city viewed rooms with 2 twin beds in each room. We were told that "City view is just a building infront of you. However, for $30 more, you would get the river view and much bigger room. I asked if it's $30 for both rooms. She said "yes, for each night". We agreed. Upon charging my card it was $30/room..I asked again, after she made the charges. She said "Yes, $30 for each room". Wait, what?!? I figured it was just a misunderstanding, so it was let go. Upon receiving our rooms, there was a huge building in the middle with peekaboo views of the river on two sides. The wall paper is ripped in the room and molds on the ceilings of the bathroom.  The room is literally just 3 feet/ 1 meter longer than our original rooms (not nuch) for almost $300. Hotel is not close to any nightlife and very quiet at night. This could be a positive for some. 
Take away: We won't stay here again. Not worth our money of close to $300 per night. There are better options. We may want to stay by Merlion Park or Riverwalk.

title: “Great for Sentosa stay”
review_text: We had a comfortable stay at Amara ,  big beds, clean and big washrooms. Excellent connectivity to Sentosa attractions and also to mainland. Provides free shuttle to major train/bus stations. Breakfast has enough items , but found the vegetarian fare to be below average.  Fruits and other items were good. checking process was smooth though had to wait for 5 hours at reception as we arrived early and no room was available. I do feel the time could have been a bit shorter as  cleaning staff took almost 2+ hrs to clean rooms, could have been expedited. Still we used up the time for breakfast and swimming in hotel pool. A la carte menu is great and the preparations are really good. ( we tried vegetarian options only ) . Tried ordering  from room service but no one picked the call even after multiple attempts.  The property grounds are beautiful with grand trees and lots of foliage and some peahens roaming around , cuckoo bird calls in early morning hours. Sleep quality is good, beds are soft yet firm and there is almost no noise from corridor or adjoining rooms.

title: “Excellent location if you have conference in Marina Bay”
review_text:
The location is excellent since I have attended a conference at Marina Bay Sands.  The nearest station entrance is Esplanade.  There is no escalator on the first flight of stairs from the street level.  This will be a hassle if you plan to bring luggage.  I didn't notice an elevator nearby.  If you plan to move around the city center this is the hotel for you given the proximity to the MRT station entrance.  You can also use this station going to Bayfront and exit inside the MBS mall.

Breakfast is very ordinary.  Not so much there.  Good thing I only got one day of breakfast for my three night stay.

Room is generally clean.  I'm not sure about the carpet but I don't feel anything grainy if I walk barefoot.  The bathroom is sparkling clean and well maintained.

I brought my trunks and goggles but decided not to swim.  There is no lifeguard on duty in the pool area and the depth of the pool starts at 2 ft but most of it is about 8 ft deep.  Not recommended for families with small kids who just want to wade and play in the pool.

I'll definitely stay here again in case I will attend another conference in the area.

title: “Staycation”
review_text:
We completed a 2-day, 1-night family staycation at Amara Sanctuary Resort with our 3-year-old and overall found it to be a reasonably valued option on Sentosa, with several areas that could be strengthened to enhance the guest experience.

From a location perspective, the property requires either taking the bus from RWS or waiting for the resort’s shuttle service, which offers limited drop-off points. Streamlining transport connectivity would significantly improve convenience for families with young children.

The room was clean and comfortably spacious. The only drawback was a noticeable musky smell in the toilet, which detracted slightly from the overall comfort level.

Facilities-wise, the kids’ pool is situated quite far from the main lobby and requires walking outdoors to access it. The area was not staffed, and the pool contained many dried leaves, creating a less-than-ideal first impression in terms of hygiene and upkeep.

Dining at the hotel restaurant was acceptable. Breakfast variety was decent though not exceptional, but the provision of food vouchers during our stay was a thoughtful gesture. The restaurant staff were exceptionally friendly and welcoming—truly a highlight of the service experience. In contrast, service at the lobby could be improved; check-in and check-out processes required considerable waiting time.

Despite these gaps, the stay was still worthwhile given that the price point is one of the most reasonable on Sentosa Island. With enhancements to transport, pool maintenance, and front-of-house efficiency, the overall guest experience could be significantly elevated.

title: “Excellent stay at Amara sanctuary resort Sentosa”
review_text:
We recently stayed at Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa as a family with young children and parents, and our experience was truly enjoyable. Here’s a summary of our stay:

Good Points:

Cleanliness: The resort maintained impeccable cleanliness throughout, from the rooms to the common areas. This made our stay very comfortable, especially with young children.

Courteous Staff: The staff were exceptionally polite and attentive. They went out of their way to ensure we felt welcomed and that our needs were met.

Room Size: The Deluxe Room we stayed in was spacious and well-appointed, providing ample space for our family to relax.

Sky Pool Views: The rooftop Sky Pool offered breathtaking views – an absolute highlight of our stay. It was a serene spot to unwind while taking in the stunning surroundings.

Convenient Transportation: The resort offers a free bus service, which was incredibly handy for getting around Sentosa. Additionally, its proximity to the Sentosa bus service made exploring the island even more convenient.

Overall, Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa exceeded our expectations with its combination of great service, comfortable accommodations, and excellent amenities. It’s an ideal choice for families and anyone looking for a relaxing getaway on Sentosa Island. We would love to return in the future!

I did see the serving staff and security staff stepping in to deliver food to the room and assisting with restaurant enquiries respectively.

The grounds around the resort is nice and it was good to walk around after breakfast to explore the heritage trail on site. Spotted 2 pairs of peacocks and peahends enjoying the sun during our walk.

Apart from that, the hotels location right in the CBD is good if you're on a business trip, but somewhat unnerving at night when almost all the cafes and restaurants nearby are closed and everything is dark. Nothing is far in Singapore but next time I'll pick a hotel by the river so I don't need a cab to get to a morning riverside run.

title: “Our Honest Staycation Review ”
review_text:
We booked the Family Room at Amara Sanctuary, expecting a fun and comfortable staycation for the kids. The room comes with a large bed (either queen or king, I honestly forgot), and two single beds for the children. But unfortunately, the experience didn’t start off well.

🛏️ Room Condition:
	•	The aircon wasn’t cold, even after we left it running for over an hour.
	•	The room had a stale, musty smell.
	•	The wardrobe door was loose, and felt like it could fall off anytime.
	•	Bathroom floor was badly stained, and the drain cover was half open when we entered.
	•	The tap at the sink was faulty, causing water to splash everywhere when turned on.

🏊 Pool Facilities:

We brought the kids to the children’s pool (Dream Pool), but it was visibly dirty and poorly maintained, so we left shortly after. We then tried the rooftop pool, which was cleaner—until we saw an unsupervised boy washing his slippers in the pool. That was a no-go for us, and we left again.

🛠️ Service Recovery:

After we returned to the room and found the aircon still not working, we called for assistance. The technician came to fix it, but the room remained warm. Eventually, the manager came to inspect the room. He was apologetic and aware of the room’s condition.

We were then upgraded to a newly renovated suite, which was a huge improvement. The room was clean, modern, and much more comfortable. The pool in the suite area was clean, though the jacuzzi wasn’t working.

⸻

✅ Overall Thoughts:
	•	Old wing: needs serious maintenance
	•	Cleanliness: inconsistent, especially pool areas
	•	Service: polite and responsive, with a good recovery
	•	New wing: much better and actually enjoyable

title: “Worst experience ever ”
review_text:
My boyfriend proposed to me on new year's eve at amara sanctuary resort, he booked a family suite with living area and it was the most disappointing experience/staycaytion ever in our lives. There seems to not be any staff working in the hotel at all! There was absolutely no way to request for an extra towel/a bottle of water and there is not a single staff at the front desk at all(be it day or night). My boyfriend did specially contact the hotel(after calling their hotel hotline for 2 days) and spoke to a staff named ftanton informing him that he will be proposing and if there could be any special arrangements or even a slice of cake, but nothing.. they could provide nothing, not even a slice of cake or a "congratulations" note even. When we checked in, the toilet drainage was choked and there was a very foul smell, the tissue box holder in the toilet vanity top was very dusty with white flaky stuff on top of it. We tried calling the operator/house keeping to gey extra towels and a bottle of water, but no one picked up after calling for 40 minutes. We tried to scan the QR code for room service but their website is down too. The following day when we wanted to order in room dining, we could not as well as no one picked up the phone and their website for service request is down still..
This is the most disappointing and worst staycaytion experience ever in our lives! To think that we actually even wanted to hold our wedding ceremony/dinner at their hotel! We will never visit ever again in our lives!

title: “Poor hotel management spoil holiday mood totally”
review_text:
Waited 2 hours to get our room. Check-in was at 3 pm and everyone came at the same time. Started with only 1 check-in counter and opened the second only after 3 4 guests were checked in. There were about 25 guests in the queue. To prevent crowding in the lobby, possibly due to fear of Safe Distancing Ambassadors, the last 20 groups of guests were given queue numbers and ushered into a small function room to continue waiting while seated. The room was hot and small. Kudos to the security and concierge for thinking quickly and moving us out of the sun into a semi-oven. One of the security staff also did very well to try to appease all the guests. All the way to the end, there were only 2 counters opened.

Our check-in took slightly less than 6 minutes. But we waited another 15 minutes for a room with 2 twin beds. Won't book ever again. I believe all can be improved through proper planning. We booked 3 weeks in advance, no reason for the management to not know/arrange for the room setup in advance. Poor check-in staff had to hold us while her housekeeping colleague rushed to change the room from a king bed setup to 2 twin beds setup.

Please please implement staggered check-in hours and prepare the room list in advance for the check-in and housekeeping staff.

Giving the minimum rating as a warning for all potential guests.

Stayed for 3 days 2 nights for long weekend. 
I was so excited for the trip until i stepped in the hotel lobby. Very old hotel with no aircon in the lobby. But it is still acceptable because they did provide a big fan to air the area while waiting to check in. 
We got our room (401) for our deluxe king room. The room is generally very old including old noisy cabinets, carpet, bathtub with mosaic cracked fixed with cement. The room provided is not the same like in the pictures. There is no shower place, which have to stand on bathtub to shower, at the same time water leaked somewhere flooded the toilet bowel area. No bidet provided also. Don’t choose the room if you looking for quiet rest. There is no soundproof at all while all the people walking pass the room, we can hear it clearly. The kind size bed is a bit hard for my husband. The tv is not connecting to wifi when we want to watch Netflix. We unable to reach the front counter cause the phone provided is not functioning. We need to scan QR code to raise the issue, but no one respond after few minutes. We have to walk to lobby to call technician to help us to fix the issue. Noted that is quite late in time already but at least they should fix the phone so that we manage to reach the front counter when we encounter any issues. Basically we are not resting well during the trip which we are looking forward initially. 
Other than that, the room is spacious and no odour. The breakfast has variety of choices. The hotel is walking distance to the train station and there are free shuttle van provided to travel to vivocity at selected timing.

title: “Good ambience ”
review_text:
I recently enjoyed a delightful one-night staycation at the Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay for my birthday on the 11th, and I must say the experience was highly satisfactory. The hotel provided an exceptional urban escape, blending beautiful design with thoughtful service.
🛏️ Room & Comfort
The room itself was spacious and well-appointed, perfect for a solo stay. The balcony with a nice harbour view was a fantastic feature, providing a relaxing backdrop to my stay. The king-size bed was quite comfy and ensured a good rest, although it was a little high for a shorter person!
✨ Service & Personalized Touches
The level of personalized service truly stood out. I greatly appreciated the hotel's effort in providing a complimentary small sweet cake treat and a cute folded towel in the shape of an elephant. The accompanying birthday wish card was a very sweet gesture, making my birthday feel genuinely celebrated.
The staff interaction was also commendable. The desk staff member who asked "how's the stay so far?" demonstrated a good, attentive attitude.
🧹 Cleanliness and Minor Notes
Cleanliness throughout the room was acceptable. The only minor issue I encountered was that the bathroom door knob was not able to lock. However, as I was staying alone, this was not a major concern.

Overall, I was highly satisfied with my stay. From the spacious room and lovely view to the very thoughtful birthday amenities and friendly staff, the experience was wonderful. I definitely plan to frequent the Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay again!

I was wondering what to do when I decided to go back to the accommodation to ask if they could hold my luggage. I am so grateful that they not only took care of my bags but also allowed me to shower at the gym. Everyone at the hotel, including those at the front desk, was so kind and helpful. If I come to Singapore again, or if someone else is going to Singapore, I will definitely recommend Parkroyal Collection! 🩵 
Also, when I walked in, the bed was beautifully arranged, and they gave me chocolate as a gift—good, good! The location is great, the hygiene is good, and the view from the floor was of Marina Bay, which was nice! I wish you an abundance of good things and happiness. I hope a day comes when I can visit again! 💚

- The air conditioning is cold and there's an air purifier, making the air feel fresh.

- The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service.
- They offer luggage storage even after I checked out.
- The room is not very soundproof, so some noise from outside might come through.

review_text:

We enjoyed the steamboat buffet downstairs a lot, service was good and food were fresh. I bought a ensogo voucher on the spot and paid about $42 each. We enjoyed watching some shows in the room and I particularly enjoyed resting on the leather couch and taking in the view outside. Lastly, we also took a stroll towards esplanade, night view was good and from esplanade, there was bus 75 to bring us back to the hotel. 

Staff was kind enough to let have an extra hour for check out, although I wish they have their check out at 2pm like most of the 4/5 stars hotel. I also wished the staff who did check in was more proactive and shared with us about some dining specials, rather than for me to find out for myself during check out.
