title: “Attention to details”
review_text:
Beautiful property with good cleanliness and in-room features. Excellent location with plenty of food choices. Peppermint restaurant food is strongly recommended. 

Experience short fall: Indicated stay is for birthday celebration. Reservations reached out proactively for friends’s name and birthday date details, and mentioned that a sweet treat will be arranged in the room - this did not happen throughout the entire stay.  

Reservation was also made indicated as Bday celebration at Peppermint, staff mention a piece of cake will be arranged.  Food was great and impressive. We were seated right next to the cashier.  We finished our food and waited, no cake was served. After asking if a cake is arranged, staff acknowledged and a frozen chocolate cake came after a 15 mins wait. we took a few bites and left. 
I phoned the operator on the same night that I did not get the sweet treat as what the reservation mentioned, hence I have went out and gotten my own cake would like to borrow a lighter just to light up the candle urgently. No apologies, just repeating time that it’s hotel policy that lighters can’t be given, there’s nothing can be done. They eventually gotten the housekeeping staff to light the candle for us after effort persuasion. 
It was a pretty disappointing experience for the birthday celebrant and embarrassing experience for myself. It is absolutely fine if nothing special can be arranged. It’s not about expecting “free things”. But if committed, it should be delivered.

title: “Nice hotel but beware of carpark charges (for drivers)”
review_text: It's the cheapest 5* hotel near Bay Area n its the first hotel we stayed that is thoughtful to adjust baby cot height. It's our 2nd stay with this hotel however they just changed their policy n we may consider others Bay Area hotel after this issue. The front desk manager (Sheldon) informed us its 1 complimentary parking ticket PER DAY, however at the concierge, the staff refused our request n informed us it's 1 complimentary parking ticket PER STAY. When question further how about 4D3N? We can't be copping up at this area for 4 Days?! The concierge staff told us as long it's over the weekend n up to 3 conservative nights it's 1 complimentary parking ticket PER STAY. Even after the front desk manager explained to them it's 1 ticket per day not per stay, they still refused to accommodate. For drivers, careful if u are staying more than 2 nights staycation or if u are driving from Malaysia. Unless u are ok to struck at this area for few days or u may need to take Taxi if u have emergency matters n leave ur car in the carpark. FYI, the carpark charges for 3D2N is S$116.

review_text:
Ok, I've to say that I'm really impressed by the cleanliness and the welcoming and homely atmosphere exuded by the exquisitely designed room and furnishings. Having vents for the wardrobe door is practical as it allows for sufficient ventilation for clothes. The bedsheets were pristine, and so was the bathtub. I could actually use the bathtub and sit in it. Yes, it's soooo clean. The pool was clean and beautiful too. 
However, I'm not satisfied with how solo guests are allocated seats during breakfast. It seems that guests who dine alone are all allocated a seat at a communal table, which seriously reminds me of a school canteen. I can even have a seat with more privacy at a fast food restaurant. Thus, I did not really enjoy my breakfast even though there was a really wide variety of food. I would expect a seat with more privacy at a restaurant located in a 5 star hotel.

On arrival I received a welcome card addressed to someone else which is always a little disconcerting. The quality of breakfast was poor with limited options of fruits, mainly apple and watermelon, and poor quality coffee. 

The meetings ng was a small group or 25 people in a small room which should be able to adjust to the temperature but had insufficient sound to hear videos, ceiling lighting which pointed into the attendees eyes and poor acoustics which made it difficult to hear people in the small meeting room. The buffet lunch and breaks were also cheap and poor quality. At one point we ran out of coffee beans in the coffee machine as the service was so poor. 

On departure we ordered taxis for 6:00pm and went down to dash to the airport to discover that they were not ordered and we required to wait for 30 due to them not being ordered and needed to rush to the airport.

title: “A nice getaway missing the "heartware"”
review_text:
I came across numerous negative reviews of this resort on various portals and was apprehensive about my stay but I was greeted with a clean room w/o any major issues. Aircon was working fine and no leakages/mould in the bathroom (these were mainly the issues reported by other travellers). The facilities, however, are clearly dated e.g. the office chair inside the room was badly peeling.

Sentosa is a great getaway venue and Amara certainly had the vibes for a relaxing time. Unfortunately though, the staff were clearly lacking the software needed for the hospitality industry. E.g. when I arrived, I was carrying my sleeping toddler and was standing in line to check in. Imagine having to stand around with heavy bags and a 13kg weight on your shoulder. The staff paid no attention to me, not once offering me any assistance. A couple arrived shortly after me and coincidentally one of the check in counters cleared up. Before I could step forward, the couple did and were promptly served by the staff so I had to continue standing in line to wait carrying all the weight. It took maybe another 10 - 15 mins before I was finally served. 

Only one of the staff bothered to greet me when crossing paths which is very unexpected. I've had much better experiences are other 4/5* establishments. Considering how many other hotels there are on Sentosa island, this would be one of my least fav choices going forward.

So yes, I would recommend this resort because of its idyllic setting and decently clean and good size rooms/bathrooms but don't expect too much service while you are there.

When I arrive at my room, I found out that my request for king bed that I input when making reservation was not fulfilled and was given a twin bed. Called to reception and was informed no king bed is available due to hotel full occupancy. Upon checking the room, realise that it is very dusty, bathtub is moldy and there are some stains and hair that looks like pubic hair. Worst of all, there are "stains" that looks like semen on the balcony sliding door. Overall experience is disappointing, front desk did give an upgrade to deluxe room with balcony upon check in as it is my partners birthday but no service recovery rendered for the service shortfall. Resort is clearly short staffed as well. Claims to be a 5 star resort but it isn't as there isn't any personalization, service is mediocre and room is not well maintained unfortunately.

title: “Dismal Experience”
review_text:
Good effort when Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa recognised the snaking line at check-in (automated and contactless check-in’s are rather commonplace now so you may want to look into that) to offer a queue number and light refreshments in a temporary waiting room. However, with only 2 counters open and each taking about 10 minutes per customer, hauling 5 customers back in line seems rather premature.

Finally, at the counter, when asking for a corner room, I was asked if I was willing to compromise being on the ground floor since that’s where the only corner room was available. Preferring quiet over a view, I agreed. Alas, upon reaching my room door, I can’t help but ponder how was mine considered a corner when there were rooms on either sides. 

Of course, there could be reasons I did not know about, like the corner room being inhospitable, thereby making mine the ‘corner’ instead. Regardless, even if I had wanted to ask someone, about that or why my tv channels were not working, no one answers the preset ‘reception’, ‘concierge’ or ‘duty manager’ numbers, after countless tries. 

I managed to find out from the staff that there was a fault with the provider when I was on my way out to dinner. They said they were on top of it but nothing changed for the rest of the night. 

I wish I could say I would be willing to pay as much to come back again. I’m afraid I can’t.

2. 시설
에어컨 필터나 정수기 필터가 잘 교체되고 있지는 않은 것 같습니다. 아직은 신축이라 괜찮은데 조금 더 시간이 지나면 필터의 청결함은 보장 못할 것 같습니다. 현재 정수기는 괜찮다고 쳐도, 에어컨은 온도를 조금만 올려도 곰팡이 냄새가 납니다. 

수압은 싱가포르 자체가 수압이 낮은 국가라 감안하면 보통입니다. 다만, 온수는 샤워실에만 나오고, 비누가 비치되어 있지 않습니다. 제가 썼던 방은 세면대 위생이 조금 별로였습니다. 


3. 직원
직원 응대는 굉장히 친절합니다. 다만 첫날 체크인할때 보증금 50불을 내야 합니다. 

4.위치
우선, 이 지역 자체가 인도인 거주지 근처라 인도인들이 굉장히 많이 보입니다. (물론 주위에 큰 호텔도 있어 관광객도 많음). 다만 mrt 라벤더 역이 지근거리라 mrt를 주로 이용하실 분에게는 괜찮은 선택지인 것 같습니다. 

5. 편의시설
숙소 앞에 세븐일레븐과 페어프라이스가 있습니다.  그리고 역 입구쪽에 길거리 음식 파는 곳, 맥도날드가 있고 뒤쪽엔 토스트박스가 있긴 한데 저는 잘 이용을 안했습니다. 

조금만 걸어서 나가시면(5분) 뒷편 아페리아몰(aperia mall)이 있는데 오히려 저는 이곳에서 이것저것 해결하시는 것을 추천합니다. 한인 식당(분식집)도 괜찮았고, Tim ho wan 이라는 홍콩 음식점도 괜찮았습니다. 몰 자체가 꺠끗하고 음식도 괜찮았으며, 스타벅스가 있습니다. 한인마트도 조그마하게 있습니다. 

총평하자면, 시설이나 위치 면에서 아쉬운 게 있어도 나름 적응하면 편하게 지내다 올 수 있는 곳입니다. 근데 다음에 싱가포르 여행을 간다면 돈 조금 더 보태더 더 좋은 숙소 갈 것 같아요.

title: “It was clean and nice!”
review_text: As mentioned in other reviews, there are a supermarket called FairPrice and a 7-Eleven, which are great for a quick meal after your schedule! The FairPrice supermarket is open until 11 PM! Within walking distance, there are places like Toast Box, Ya Kun Kaya Toast, and McDonald's, so the location is great. It's also close to Lavender Station, and it's about a 7-8 minute walk to Bendemeer Station! We used a Superior Double room as a couple, and although we were worried because people said it was small, it was enough space to open two small suitcases! There’s a water dispenser outside the room, providing hot water as well. The amenities provided include toothbrushes, small toothpaste, shampoo, and body wash, and towels are provided according to the number of guests. If you hang the request for cleaning on the door handle when you go out and return, they’ll clean and provide new towels. You can also request extra if needed! Plus, the staff is friendly too, haha. It seems like baggage storage is available until around 10-11 PM. The air conditioning is adjustable and cool, and the bed was comfortable, making it an accommodation with no drawbacks! We are not picky either; we just finished our schedule, washed up, and lay down to watch a movie, hehe. I recommend it!!

title: “Awesome stay”
review_text:
It was my first time doing a staycation, and I was initially uncertain about it, fearing it might not be exciting. However, it turned out to be an amazing experience. I was thrilled with the room and surroundings. The bed felt like a 5-star hotel, and my son loved staying on the bed while watching his favorite shows. 

The kiddie pool could use some improvements and better maintenance since it's somewhat isolated. The infinity pool on the 4th floor is 1.38m deep, which frustrated my son as he couldn't play much. Providing pool floats for kids would make the swimming experience more enjoyable. 

The buffet breakfast selection was limited but satisfactory. The restaurant staff, especially MJ, Rachel, and Jennifer, were incredibly nice, cheerful, and helpful, making breakfast a pleasant experience with their warm smiles.

The shuttle service could be improved by adding a beach station to its drop-off points, as the only current ways to reach the beach are by monorail from Vivocity or walking from Resorts World drop-off point.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we might consider booking again, possibly opting for villas with their own jacuzzi. By the way, my son loved the warm bath in our room's bathtub. :)

We were deciding between Amara Sanctuary and Baracks. We choose this over the latter and we were not disappointed.

This is our 4th returning trip since the birth of our 8 yr old kid. Althought dated, their hospitable staffs made up for it.

We were warmly greeted by Judy the front staff upon arrival at 10am and registered before leaving for our activities. When we were back at 3.30pm, we recieved our key card promptly. Note that breakfast are at some $37.90 and kids at half price, served via ala cart buffet from their menu. Should be more valued when choosen at time of booking with hotel. Do book your pool hours should you wish to have a dip or swim as any 1 hour there's limitation of 5 pax. Applies to sentosa public beach for bookings over the weekend as well.

We were given inside facing twin beds. Opt for seaview if could. Nevertheless it seems like our rooms are more spacious. Provided with basic standard bath kits l.e.toothbrush, shaver, lemongrass shanpoo, conditioner, lavender body wash and a large bath tub. The cleaniness shower area can be improved ( - for this) The mini fridge has replenishable orange juices and coke. Not forgetting generous provisions of 4 drinking bottles of water.

While my family is making way to the dream pool under the drizzling rain, not one but 2 of the staff generously offered their umbrellas.

Generally i will still return to this hotel based on her excellent location and assessibility between the beach (12mins to palawan) and USS (20mins). They do provide shutter buses to casino and vivocity, just be 5mins ahead of pick up time.

title: “Safety concerns”
review_text:
We recently stayed at Amara Sanctuary on 4-5 March 2022. It was highly disappointing. We felt the need to express our concerns over the safety aspect of the resort. 

The room we stayed in (couple suite with pool access 809) was behind a gate which we could not open with our card hence we had to climb stairs which were in a dimly lit area. Over the weekend it rained heavily too which made the climb at night more treacherous. The path to the reception had wires taped and carpeted over - someone can trip over as there was a general slant in gradient of the walkway. 

The wooden decking at the private pool was wobbly at certain areas especially right outside our room where i tripped twice before we manually cordoned it off ourselves.

The stones at the pool were sharp and we observed algae.

The tub in our room is leaking which caused the areas around it to be very slippery and the tub was grossly stained.

The wall above the bed has what looks like black mold - we aren't sure if that's safe to breathe in.

The nespresso machine kept dispensing murky water even though we rinsed it out several times.

The walls are very thin and we could hear babies and children cry at night.

The pillows were lumpy. 

Even though we selected twin beds, we only only told upon check-in that this room type has only king beds.

When we attempted to call and use the app for checkout services such as buggy luggage assistance, we were kept waiting for 45 mins.

Our lunch tray was left outside for almost 12 hours before someone cleared it - our calls were unanswered. 

I have taken some photos. It was pouring when we arrived at the hotel. Looking forward to drying ourselves and washing up upon checking in, we were told that the room wasn't ready (check in time was stated 3pm, we arrived at 3.30pm).  We were told to wait or go explore. It was still raining. Where can we go? Front desk mentioned that once the room was ready, she would give us a call.
We headed to the hotel's restaurant to grab something to eat while waiting. As I was having my meal, I felt water droplets dripping on me. And then onto my plate! It was from the air-conditioning vents. I mentioned this to the female staff and she replied me, "Oh, ya, it's the condensation." "Oh, okay okay" was her reply when I told her it dripped onto my plate and that they shouldn't put customers there if they knew the vents were dripping.
We did not receive any calls to inform us that our room was ready until we called them. I dont know what happened to calling us when the room is ready. Upon entering our room, we found out that they had not brought our bag (which was deposited at the lobby) up and once again had to call and ask about it. The staff on the line told us we had to go collect it ourselves. When asked why couldn't we just tell her the number on the slip, she said she had to check. Shouldn't the staff who checked us in not tagged it to our room? 30 minutes after the call, someone finally brought the bag up.
In the evening, we called for some ice and a bottle opener. To our surprise, this 5-star hotel required us to go down to get them ourselves. Short handed or staff that couldn't be bothered, we really can't tell anymore at this point.

It was our anniversary but we encountered the worst service and experience we ever had. We will definitely not consider another stay at Amara.

Only stay here if you're desperate or interested to see how easily the staff will aid others in theft.

title: “Memorable stay”
review_text:
We had a lovely stay at Parkroyal Marina Bay, and overall it was a very comfortable and pleasant experience for our family.
We really loved the ambiance — the lobby with its lush greenery feels calming and refreshing, and Peppermint restaurant is very spacious and well laid out. The Urban Garden outside adds a nice eco-friendly touch that makes the whole space feel thoughtful and relaxing.
The pool isn’t very big, and it would be amazing if the grassy patch nearby could be expanded into a larger pool area (or even turned into a jacuzzi!), but despite that, the elevated pool level offers beautiful views of the surrounding buildings. At night especially, it feels cosy and almost magical.
Our room was generously sized, and the daybed made a huge difference — my husband, two kids, and I all slept comfortably without needing extra beds. The bathroom was reasonably spacious as well. Location-wise, it’s excellent — being so close to Marina Square with endless food options, and Suntec City nearby, made everything very convenient.
One downside was the TV system, which wasn’t very user-friendly. We couldn’t connect to YouTube, Netflix, or Disney+, which would have been nice, especially with kids.
That said, room service portions were generous and satisfying, and housekeeping did a great job keeping everything clean and pleasant throughout our stay.
Overall, a great stay with a lovely atmosphere, comfortable rooms, and an excellent location. We’d be happy to return.

title: “Choose solo travelers without exception.”
review_text:
I am a solo traveler from Korea. 
I came to Singapore with just a small carry-on suitcase. 

I didn’t need a spacious and fancy room. However, I also didn't want a dirty and unreliable room. On the other hand, going to an expensive hotel felt like such a waste. 

Then I found this hotel, which offered a private room for a very reasonable price of about 90,000 won per night, so I chose this hotel. 

In conclusion, it was a great choice. 

The hotel was easily accessible from MRT Lavender and Bendemeer stations, and there are Fairprice and hawker centers nearby. These facilities are very helpful in saving travelers' budgets. 

The area is similar to Japanese business hotels, but the actual usable space is much larger. 

All the furniture and the bed are efficiently arranged, providing a wide living space relative to the room area. 

I want to praise every aspect: reasonable price, excellent MRT accessibility, surrounding businesses, and the cleanliness of the hotel. 

I especially want to commend the reception staff on the first floor, a blonde woman with a height of about 150-160 cm. 

She was very kind and considerate towards me and was fluent in Korean. 

Thanks to her, my first impression of this hotel greatly improved. 

In the end, I stayed for two nights from December 6 to 8 and then another night on December 11 to 12. 

Honestly, if it weren't for her professional and friendly service, I would have canceled my existing reservation and moved my accommodation near MRT Rochor. 

In fact, my viable options were just this place and Rochor Station. 

However, thanks to her kind and thoughtful service, I ended up staying here again. 

If I visit Singapore again, I will definitely come back to this place. 

I only regret not being able to note down her name. 

Thank you, nameless woman. I had a good rest at Beverly Hotel. See you next time.

The front desk guy who took us to our room was unprofessionally rude when we were clarifying directions to our room. We got told to use cups in the room when we asked for new extra ones, and the breakfast food did not even come with condiments (chili sauce) and the right number of utensils.

1) After checking in, I was told to wait at the side and someone would attend to me so that they can bring me to my Villa. I waited with my wife and my infant and was never attended to. We saw others checking in and being brought to their rooms so I went up to the person who checked me in and asked if someone was going to attend to me, he replied " you have to wait in queue" in a very rude tone. So we then proceeded to the buggy queue and waited for the buggy. Once buggy arrived, no one bothered to assist us to help us load our bags onto the buggy, my wife was carrying our infant so she couldn't help me. What shocked me most is the staff just stood there watching. 

2) Went in our villa and the floor and walls were dusty.

3) I headed out to purchase some items for my family and when I returned to the lobby, I asked the staff which way is best to head to my Villa as it's raining heavily, the reply was " there is no shelter so you will be wet". The buggy was there and the staff didn't even offer to send me on the buggy to my Villa. For a place like Amara Sanctuary which charges exorbitant price, the least I would aspect is to have some basic customer service level.

I felt bad for my wife as it was her birthday but she lost her excitement the moment we started our check in process.

title: “Business/Leisure”
review_text: I arrived into Changi Airport (SIN) in the early morning hours. I remained at the airport until approx. noon before I took the MRT via the East/West Line to the City Hall Station. I accessed the City Link mall walkway just after exiting through the turnstiles and wound my way around the underground shopping areas until I eventually exited via escalator somewhere near the hotel. I approached the front lobby on the fourth floor and inquired about the possibility of an early check in.  A room in the category I had reserved was not available but the gal at the front desk advised that I could check my luggage on the first floor lobby area and my luggage would be brought to my assigned  room later in the afternoon once my room was a available. Long and short  - once inside my room it was clean, comfortable and the view of the  Marina Resevoir and it’s surroundings were spectacular! The location is excellent and food and shopping opportunities abound due to the hotel’s location near two malls

title: “Exceptional”
review_text:
Easy to find hotel, clean, not musty, with housekeeping cleaning constantly. Conveniently located near MRT Lavender, about a 3-minute walk, and approximately a 30-minute ride from Terminal 2 Changi Airport. The entrance to the building is a bit small, and there is a bus stop nearby. There is an Aperia mall behind the hotel, with a food center, kitchen center, supermarket, Burger King, McDonald's, 7-11, and an ATM across the street.

- The room is clean and fairly soundproof but may be a bit small for 2 people. It has complete amenities: towels, hot and cold water dispenser, hair dryer, bidet hose, TV, and a small refrigerator that can fit small bottles and cans. There is one type A power outlet available, so a universal adapter is not needed. No bottled water is provided, but there are cups available to get water from the water dispenser on each floor.

- The staff provides good service, explaining the conditions in detail, and are available at the counter 24 hours. You can leave your bags there beforehand.

- There is a deposit of 50 Singapore dollars which does not accept cash**. Debit/credit cards can be used, and you will get it back after check-out within 1 month.

We stayed from November 25-28, 2023. The adjacent building is under renovation, so there may be some noise in the late morning.

I booked a marina view, and while the view is nice, it's a bit disappointing that there's construction visible in front of it. This is something that can be seen from any hotel's marina bay view, so it's unavoidable, haha. If you plan to enjoy a staycation, I recommend it. However, if you're just planning to sleep at the hotel and enjoy the pool a bit, you can have fun at a place with lower prices by sacrificing the view! I was just a tourist, so while the accommodation was good, I feel like I couldn't really enjoy it, which is a bit disappointing. Oh, and by the way, if you visit the pool at night, you can take great photos, so check the pool hours and don't forget to take some pictures, haha!

Upon my check in , asked them if they had done the decoration and they said yes but didn’t request for any payment , a little weird but thought the payment was to be made after , little did I the decoration was only “ Happy Birthday “ laid on the bed in gold ! Went back to the front desk and asked about the decoration , and their excuse was “ oh it’s too late to request “, “ need to pay $300 for decoration  “, “ we really tried but that’s the best we can do “ …. Such a disappointment . Could have went out to get myself the decoration items and decorated it myself for less than $300 if I knew it’ll turn out like this . Good thing is that gave a plate of fruits and desserts in a 3 tier stainless steel lunch box as a compensation . Secondly, the house keeping couldn’t really understand and speak English that well … requested for broom with dustpan and they gave me a pool skimmer . Asked for broom with dustpan in another context and they gave me a coconut stick broom … Apart from that , just a friendly reminder to bring as much insect repellent as you can as there’s a lot of mosquitoes and other unwanted insects . Overall, I enjoyed my stay there . No disturbance and it’s really very peaceful .

title: “Excellent”
review_text:
Stayed for 3 nights as a solo traveler in Superior Twin Room.

Pros: 
- Close to Lavender MRT station, which is on the same line as the airport line. 
- Lots of eateries around, close to NTUC supermarket and a small shopping mall.
- Nice, clean, and bright room. Comfortable beds.
- Quick and easy check-in/check-out. Friendly and efficient 24-hours receptionists. 
- Friendly and efficient cleaners (uncle and auntie).
- TV, AC, lights, exhaust fan, in-room safe box, and hot water all work as expected.
- Got some discount from Agoda, which is a bonus.

Cons:
- Walk-in shower, so the whole bathroom and toilet bowl are wet after a shower.
- No kettle to boil hot water, but there is a hot water dispenser outside the room, which is shared with the other guests.

In summary, it's a nice, new, and modern hotel with friendly staff in a great location. I will stay here again when I am back in Singapore.

In total the 3 meals cost me $260 for my husband and I and they were very disappointing

I will not return to the hotel.

title: “Poor service”
review_text:
We are very disappointed  with our recent stay at your amara hotel last Oct 25-26. Unfortunately, the experience did not meet the standards expected from a 5-star establishment.
Several issues affected our stay:
There was no bidet in our toilet room.
When we used the hair iron, it caused a power trip.
During the breakfast buffet, guests had to clear their own plates due to an apparent lack of staff.
When we raised these concerns with a staff member on duty, she mentioned that these problems happen frequently and that feedback has already been given to management without any action being taken.
While I appreciate that your staff were friendly and doing their best, it’s clear they are struggling due to poor maintenance and insufficient manpower. Guests choose a 5-star hotel to relax and enjoy a stress-free stay, not to deal with multiple inconveniences.
I sincerely hope management takes these issues seriously and implements improvements soon. Your team deserves better support, and your guests deserve the level of service they pay for.

The girl told me “hold on” and was chatting with some other people then hang up on me abruptly. I called back and noone pick up. I tried to call a few more times for more than one hour later, someone finally picked up.  Isnt it common courtesy to call the person back if you hang up abruptly? Instead, I called them and waited for more than an hour.  

Secondly, I wanted to order room service.
The QR code is not working. Again, I called room service, receptionist, concierge and took them more than one hour to get back to me just for a menu. 

Thirdly, I asked their staff to bring the cake over to my room by 12am for my boyfriend’s birthday surprise. He said ok and NOONE CAME.
I awkwardly brought my boyfriend to the reception counter and asked for his birthday cake. If you cant do it, at least tell me. I could have planned other ways. Don’t promise if you can’t deliver. 

Overall, it is not worth my money. I think lower stars hotel can provide better service than them.

review_text:
No signage between ckeck-in counter and lift, which can't be seen. No one to help provide information. Hotel unilaterally imposes exorbitant charges on what are usually complimentary items even in a 1-star hotel, e.g. sachets of substandard coffee. Two bottles of 1-ltr Evian water are deceptively placed on the counter and charged at S$16 for the twin pack (if you by mistake consume one bottle, you're still liable to pay the full amount), yet the nearest supermarket that carries the 1-ltr mineral water is the Cold Storage at Plaza Singapura. It's not available at the same supermarket across the road (a likely tactic of the hotel).

Xmas & new yr are busy periods. Instead of extending the breakfast time, the hotel cared more about its own convenience by shortening the breakfast time.

The hotel claims "You are the centre of our world" when in fact "M" (which ironically stands for money) is their concern and centre.

I won't come to this hotel again!

title: “Disappointing Experience During Our Staycation at Amara Sentosa (21–22 Nov 2025)”
review_text:
We’re disappointed to share that our recent staycation at Amara Sentosa from 21 to 22 November 2025 was marred by an unfortunate experience. After dining at the hotel’s breakfast buffet, both my daughter and I began feeling unwell shortly afterward, experiencing severe diarrhoea and vomiting. While we cannot confirm the exact cause, the timing was concerning enough that we felt it was important to highlight this for the hotel to review its food handling and dining practices so that other guests do not encounter a similar issue.

This was especially disheartening because we have been loyal customers of the hotel. I had even written a complimentary review about our previous stay, praising the service and hospitality. This time, however, we were shocked by the decline in service quality—from the front desk to the restaurant.

When we started feeling sick, we called the front desk to request a slightly later checkout beyond 12pm so we could rest and recover a little before leaving. Unfortunately, the female staff member we spoke with rejected the request without consideration, even after we explained that we had become unwell after breakfast. Her response felt extremely cold and dismissive, and we were told that there was nothing she could do. No concern at all was shown for our wellbeing. As of the evening of 23 November, my daughter was still experiencing vomiting and severe diarrhoea.

During breakfast on 22 November, we were also seated at a table for two in an area where the floor was still extremely wet from the previous day’s rain. We were told we needed to sit there due to crowd control, even though dry tables were available. The restaurant staff simply smiled and said, “be careful of the wet floor,” even though the situation was clearly unsafe. We did not want this incident to ruin our morning, so we reluctantly sat at the table, but walking required extreme caution. This was an indoor dining area, and as an older adult with a fall risk, being placed on a wet floor felt unsafe and inconsiderate. The staff’s manner came across as dismissive despite the polite smile, and it did not reflect the level of service we had previously enjoyed. On top of that, we even had to endure the noise from the same staff giving a loud training lecture while openly criticising her junior staff members nearby, which added to the discomfort of the dining experience.

Overall, we were deeply disappointed—by the lack of empathy at the front desk, the quality of the expensive BBQ dinner, the food voucher that felt unusable due to the many terms and conditions, and the poor service at the restaurant. After being loyal customers for years, this stay fell far below our expectations. We sincerely hope the hotel takes these concerns seriously so that future guests do not experience the same issues.

title: “Exceptional”
review_text:
Reviewing under my wife’s account.

During our recent stay at Amara Junior suite, we experienced a level of hospitality that far exceeded expectations, thanks to the exceptional leadership and personal commitment of the Hotel Duty Manager Shaz. What made the experience truly remarkable was the thoughtfulness and attention to detail extended to celebrate my wife's birthday.

From the moment we arrived, the service was warm, seamless, and genuinely caring. The Manager went the extra mile to ensure that every aspect of the celebration was memorable. The personalized gift plates, beautifully curated and presented,  thoughtful gestures that demonstrated a deep sense of pride in guest experience. These efforts created a lasting impression and transformed a simple stay into a truly special occasion.

It is rare to find hospitality that feels both professional and personal. The consistency of service, the attentiveness of the team, and the Manager’s proactive approach made us feel valued at every touchpoint. It is this standard of care and excellence that makes us want to return, not just for milestones and special events, but also for the simple joy of leisure stays.

Amara has not only met but surpassed the expectations of what modern luxury hospitality should embody. We look forward to making this hotel one of our preferred destinations for both personal celebrations and regular getaways.

title: “Great Budget-Friendly Stay for Short Trips”
review_text:
Other than the size of the room, this hotel is great. The bed is comfortable, the water is warm, and the shower is nice. They provide a hot and cold water dispenser for guests on every floor. They also offer early check-in, and the check-in and check-out process is smooth and easy. If you’re traveling to Singapore for a short stay, I recommend this hotel. It’s close to many convenience stores, cafés, and food courts, as well as the MRT Lavender station and Kallang bus stops.

They have a special lane for wheelchairs and strollers in case the lift doesn’t fit them. You can also park them near the lift since they cannot fit inside the room.

The lift, room, and even the hall are clean. The most wonderful feature is that the room has a large, clear glass window overlooking a nearby park and soccer field. This helps prevent the space from feeling too claustrophobic, even though the room is quite small.

I traveled with a child under 8 years old, so the space was fine. However, for older kids, the room would definitely feel too small. I had two medium suitcases, and they fit perfectly. But if you have more luggage or larger suitcases, it could be a problem.

Overall, it’s a great option for short stays and budget travelers.

title: “Terrific stay”
review_text:
I recently stayed at M Hotel on June 28 and had a very positive experience. The staff was effective, friendly, and incredibly helpful, making my check-in process smooth and enjoyable. There was an abundance of parking lots available, which made it convenient for me to access my vehicle.

The range of facilities offered was impressive, catering to a variety of needs. I must say, the cleanliness of the toilet and bathtub was outstanding; they were the cleanest I have ever used in a hotel. Additionally, I found that booking early provided excellent value for the price, which was a pleasant surprise.

The room itself was quite spacious, offering a comfortable living space. However, I did encounter one minor issue: the TV mirroring feature in my room on the 25th level did not support Smart View, unlike the room I stayed in on the 24th level during a previous visit. 

Overall, my stay at M Hotel was delightful, and I would certainly recommend it to others seeking a comfortable and accommodating experience.

title: “Mixed Experience - Food wasn't Halal”
review_text:
We recently stayed at Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa, and while there were some positive aspects, a few issues left us somewhat disappointed.
First, the location of the resort is fantastic—nestled in the lush greenery of Sentosa, offering a peaceful retreat with easy access to the island's attractions. The service provided by the staff, particularly "Nitya", was excellent. She went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable, and her warm hospitality truly stood out.
However, one significant downside for us was the food. Unfortunately, the resort does not offer Halal options, which is not ideal for Muslim guests like us. This made it challenging for us to find suitable dining options on the premises. We had to rely on external restaurants, which was inconvenient.
Additionally, we found the internet to be a bit slow, which made it difficult to stay connected, especially when trying to work or stream content.
Despite these issues, the resort itself was beautiful, and the overall experience was pleasant. However, we would recommend that the management consider providing Halal food options to better accommodate all guests.

title: “PALES IN COMPARISON TO ACTUAL "FIVE-STAR"”
review_text:
We booked a two-nights stay. On the first day upon arrival, our room was not ready until 4.00 PM even though the stipulated time was 3 PM. 

The room was not clean properly and we had to again ask housekeeping to clean the room for us. This includes even refilling handsoap and stuff. the hotel is chronically understaffed. 

We wanted to use the swimming pool near the garden which is supposed to be open till 8 pm. We went there at 7.30 and it was pitch black. no lights nothing - barring the fact we also had to use phone torch as the path was not well-lit either. 

same with the infinity pool - I HAVE NEVER - seen a swimming pool with ZERO LIGHTS whatsoever. There was none around the pool, inside the pool - these guys are waiting for a fall hazard and to get sued for injury. I asked the staff about lighting and got no satisfactory response. 

Breakfast is okayish for one night - but its the same menu daily so you will get bored easily. things are not refilled properly either - so take it or you are done. 

Coffee is literally a substandard coffee machine. no Mocha nothing. I have never seen a five-star with such standard of coffee machines. 

The hotel likely has a management issue and severely understaffed. the only face saving grace was the Indian restaurant called Verve grill just next to the hotel. 

This definitely isn't a 5-star by any means, prolly something like 3.5 stars, considering how outrageously expensive things are in Singapore.

title: “Disappointed with the inflexibility”

We understand there's a discounted rate for in-house guests.  The hotel charged the 3rd person at the full walk-in rate.  When we checked with the staff at check-out, the staff's reply was that "we should have made known to the hotel that there will be a 3rd person at breakfast and that they were unable to reverse the amount as the cashier had closed the accounts" . title: “Acceptable”
review_text:
I’m writing to express my dissatisfaction with my recent stay at your hotel. I had higher expectations, especially from a property that presents itself as a 5-star resort.

Prior to my arrival, I sent an email mentioning that this stay was to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday, and I inquired if there were any special room decorations or arrangements available. Unfortunately, I never received a reply—even after waiting for a week. This lack of response was disappointing, especially given the occasion.

Upon check-in, I was informed of a 15% discount on all activities, which was also clearly displayed on your website and banners. However, when I visited Mini Ultra Golf, I was told that your hotel was not included in the promotion. This misinformation was misleading and left us feeling let down.

The hotel itself felt very outdated and run-down. The pool shower area had one shower that wasn’t working (as shown in the attached picture), and the constant loud insect noise from morning until night made it difficult to relax by the pool. The atmosphere was far from what one would expect from a relaxing resort experience.

The breakfast was very underwhelming. The food selection was limited, and one of the dishes wasn’t labeled at all, leaving us unsure of what it was. Overall, the dining experience felt unorganized and disappointing.

The room was also far from ideal—the lighting was poor, the doors and fixtures looked old, and the bathroom floor had visible stains. The general upkeep of the property did not reflect a 5-star standard in any way.

Furthermore, on the first day, I reported a dead cockroach in the room. Despite notifying housekeeping, it was still there when I returned after the room was cleaned. This indicates a lack of attention to hygiene and cleanliness, which is concerning.

Regrettably, I do not feel that my experience was worth the cost or rating. At best, I would consider the standard to be closer to a 2 or 3-star hotel. I will not be returning, and I hope you take this feedback seriously to improve your service and facilities for future guests.

title: “Thank you for the happiness!”
review_text:
We used this hotel for our first overseas trip as a couple. Our English skills are at a level where we can understand and respond if we know the words, so we were quite anxious. However, thanks to the polite assistance of the hotel staff, we felt reassured. 

Upon arrival at the hotel, they arranged for someone to take our luggage to the room and delivered it immediately after we finished checking in. The room was very clean and tidy, and they also made sure to replenish the amenities properly. 

The breakfast buffet had a decent variety, and it seemed to change slightly from day to day, making it enjoyable. The pool was included in the accommodation cost, so we could use it for free, and since we also had access to the night pool, it was less crowded and very relaxing. 

Although we had already paid for the hotel (including breakfast) at the time of booking, we were asked for a deposit at check-in. They properly processed the refund at checkout, which was great. 

The price is on the higher side, but with this level of service, it’s worth it. If you are looking for a sense of security, I highly recommend it!

title: “A great hotel to explore Singapore”
review_text:
We booked 7 nights for our recent visit to Singapore at the Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay and we’re glad we did.  It was the ideal hotel for us in many ways.  

The location of the property is ideal. it’s just a short walk to the Esplanade for great views, bike rentals and walks around Singapore; it’s a short walk to Metro stations (though we used Grab cars for our transport); and there is the Marina Square mall literally next door with a large number of food options (and retail stores).

The hotel was very clean and well appointed and our view was spectacular!  We booked a King room with Marina Bay view.  The hotel lobby is grand and gorgeous and we were there end of November so the lobby was decorated for Christmas.  We didn’t take the opportunity for a swim but did visit the pool which was lovely.  It’s an outdoor pool with a kids' pool surrounded by the Singapore skyline.  Another little but much appreciated feature was the filtered water dispenser in the bathroom!

Should we visit Singapore again, we will definitely choose this hotel for our lodging.

title: “Stay was ruined by renovation taking place in the hotel”
review_text:
I was given a room right next to a few rooms that were having some refurbishment works. A letter was placed in my room saying that there might be some disturbances between 9 to 6. Constant drilling commenced at about 4pm all the way until 6.20pm and it didn’t sound like it was going to stop until I called reception to complain. If you say you’re going to stop at 6pm then keep to your word. In hindsight, the staff at the counter who checked me in—she also wasn’t too friendly and couldn’t even manage a single smile—should have asked if I was okay being in a room next to construction work, and I should also have asked for another room when the drilling started.

I booked into this hotel expecting a quiet afternoon but that was completely ruined, and even though it was indeed a very lovely hotel with beautiful rooms and a super comfortable bed, I feel like my money has been wasted. 

Luckily, breakfast was good. Many vegetarian options available, which is great.

Staff at check in counter was professional but seem overwhelmed. The stay was to celebrate my hubby’s birthday and I’ve arranged via email with reservations executive to prepare a complimentary cake for the stay. Nothing was delivered to our room during our 3 days 2 nights stay. Room is newly renovated but the bath tub looks old and yellow. Pool seems to be open for all and there was no staff there to ensure that only guest with reservation can enter the pool. 
Overall not worth the price we paid.  Not recommended, there are better hotels in the area at the same or lower price.

review_text: 3/4から3/11まで女1人旅で7泊しました。去年ラベンダー駅近くのホテルに泊まり立地が良かった事から今回もラベンダー駅近くのこちらのホテルにお世話になりました。部屋には歯ブラシ・シャワーキャップ・綿棒・インスタント珈琲・クリーマー・砂糖・紅茶・ハンガー×2・ドライヤー・スリッパがあり、バスルームにはバスタオル・バスマット・シャンプー・ボディソープがついてますがタオルはありませんので必要な方は持参した方がいいです。お部屋はコンパクトながら清掃がゆきとどいており床は素足でも歩けるくらいです。去年宿泊したホテル(1泊2万円位)のバスルームはとても狭く排水溝からの匂いが酷かったのですが今回のホテルはトイレとバスルームの仕切りはありませんが広さもあり水圧も良くなにより排水溝の匂いは全くありませんでした。難を言えば洗面台にコンセントがなくドライヤーをTV下にあるコンセントにさして使うのが不便でした。床にしゃがんで乾かす感じなので。あと各フロアかわかりませんが廊下にサーバーがあり水が頂けます。部屋にボトルがあるので水を入れてお部屋に置いたりペットボトルに入れて持ち歩けたのが便利でした。コンセントは冷蔵庫上に1箇所、あとはTV下のドライヤー専用❓のみなので効率よく充電をするのをお勧めします。ホテルから道路を挟んだ所に地元のお手軽スーパーもあります。フロントはホテル入り口の外にあり24時間対応、セキュリティもしっかりしていてスタッフの笑顔も素敵でした。シンガポールはホテル代が高いし暑いので駅近でなるべくローコストで清潔感のあるホテルを探していたらこちらのホテルに行きつきました。又シンガポールに行く時は利用したいと思いました。

title: “Acceptable”

title: “Beautiful hotel resort, lovely staff and great food. ”
review_text: Beautiful hotel resort, lovely staff and great food. Staff are considerate and attentive. They checked us in early after an overnight flight at no extra charge. The bed was the comfiest bed we have ever slept on throughout our travels. Very clean and pretty room. The TV could do with an upgrade, otherwise no issues. The outdoor Jacuzzi was nice. Could be a bit better with more greenery around it for added feeling of serenity.  The food at the restaurant for breakfast was ample and delicious. We stayed for our honeymoon and unfortunately staff forgot to decorate our bed as requested by my husband twice but did  so later the day before we left. We very much enjoyed our stay otherwise so these minor issues didn't greatly affect our stay. Wish we had more time in Singapore and hopefully next time we get to enjoy the infinity pool. Thank you for your hospitality during our first visit to Singapore. We will be back :)

review_text: Booked 2 rooms that’s connecting but the check-in process was quite slow. I had registered at 12:30pm but i manage to get only 1 room by 4:40PM & the 2nd room by 5:13PM. However, staff did apologise & offered a late check out at 4PM. I had in room dining as well & the food was good. However, you have to order using your mobile device so do take note if you have elderly parents who are not tech savvy.  Overall, it was a relatively good stay and the hotel was clean and spacious.

title: “Not a good experience”
review_text:
I had booked well in advance and said I would arrive late.
Upon arrival, I had to wait to check in with only one member of staff on duty. I was told I would be upgraded because all other rooms were full. This sounded like good news but it was not.
My washbasin was completely blocked so I could not use it properly. Then I was woken in the night by an appalling smell of sewage from the bathroom which persisted until the morning.
I complained to the reception staff on leaving. They barely seemed interested in what I had to say. 
The restaurant was noisy and full of small children. The main bar was impossible to sit in early evening (7pm) with colleagues because of the noise of the music - the staff seemed to think they should turn it into a disco, despite the fact that it was nearly empty.
This hotel was very poor value and not suitable for business travellers.

title: “"Slow start" but finished well. ”
review_text:
To be fair, I mixed up the check in with check out timings so I came at around 1pm instead of 3pm thinking I was late. Hence the so called "slow start". I was wondering where everyone was, they were just not expecting me to be checking in so early. It was raining too, so it just made everything harder. 

But thereafter, the staff were all helpful and accommodating.

I especially like Arel from the Sanctuary Tearoom. 

His service is really top notch. His attention to detail unparalleled. He noticed that the sun was glaring in my eyes during breakfast and immediately brought those big umbrellas to shade me.

In the afternoon, he cracked a joke I couldn't remember but still brightened my day. He saw me wearing a back brace and immediately brought a cushion for me.

I would come back here just to get a dose of Arel's good vibes. He's simply simply the best.

review_text:
The charm of colonial buildings are what  excites us as we travelled on a buggy ride to our room. We had a Courtyard Suite with Jacuzzi & it was beautiful from the white-gated front porch to the four-poster bed to the jacuzzi at the backyard. There's even a bunker in front which the kids explored. 

We asked for 2 baby cots becaus3 we have twins & the cots fit nicely in the spacious room. Told me at 1st that the cots were meant for under 1-year-olds though. But my 19-month olds had more than ample space & slept the whole night through in those cots. I think a 2-year-old can still fit nicely. Much safer too than rolling off the bed. 

We ordered room service for breakfast & it was a lovely meal which came rather fast.

We had a nature walk & saw peacocks, squirrels & cockatoos. Kids truly love the wide spaces for walks & also the buggy rides.

However, granted that the resort is on historical site & in nature, we don't think the cleanliness of the room needs to be a 'rustic'. Nothing that a small toothbrush can't clean for the stains in the sink, below the tap, on parts of the floor of the jacuzzi shower area. I think for the price, a little bit more attention to cleanliness would be desired. When we stayed at Lexis Hibiscus, it was dust-free, sand-free eventhough it was on-water & breezy. 

Other than that, we had a lovely stay & thank you for the pretty, little birthday cake for my Husband.

My partner and I had a fantastic stay at this hotel — everything was truly five-star from start to finish.

The location couldn’t be better — close to great restaurants, shopping, and key attractions, yet still peaceful and relaxing. It made exploring the area so convenient and enjoyable.

The room was cozy, beautifully furnished, and perfect for a romantic getaway. We especially loved the comfortable bed and the stunning view from our window. Every detail was well thought out, and the space felt warm and inviting.

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, always going the extra mile to make us feel welcome. Their hospitality really made a difference in our stay.

Whether you’re celebrating something special or just looking for a quiet escape, I highly recommend this hotel for couples. We’re already looking forward to coming back!

title: “Paid Premium for a Villa, Received Unacceptable Service – Completely Disappointing”
review_text:
I booked and paid a premium for the One-Bedroom Villa at Amara Sentosa to celebrate my son’s birthday, expecting a quality experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the most disappointing stays we’ve ever had.

From check-in, it was obvious the property was severely understaffed. We made more than 50 unanswered calls to reception throughout our stay, with no one available to assist. There was also no return buggy service due to no one answering the reception calls, forcing our guests to walk to the carpark on their own, from the villa which is faraway from the carpark. 

I personally informed staff (Shafiq) at check-in of our needs such aa extra chairs, water, and ice cubes, and he wrote everything down right in front of me,  but nothing was ever arranged. 
Later, when we used the villa’s hair dryer, the entire unit lost power. - lights, air-con, tv, all were shut off. We tried calling reception for help repeatedly, but no one answered, and my husband had to walk all the way to the lobby to get assistance.

To make matters worse, a birthday cake delivery arranged for 7:30 p.m. was misplaced by the hotel, causing unnecessary confusion. One of our guests had to personally locate and collect the cake instead of the hotel staff.

After all that, the hotel tried to impose a $300 “excessive trash” charge - something that was never communicated before or during check-in. Despite multiple emails, clear evidence, and even setting deadlines, the hotel has failed to respond for over a week.

For a stay that cost a premium, the service level and lack of accountability are completely unacceptable. This experience not only ruined our celebration but also embarrassed us in front of our guests.

Strongly not recommended until the property addresses its serious service and communication issues.

title: “Good hotel. Close to Universal Studio”
review_text:
The hotel is located about 700 meters from Universal Studio. If you're looking for an affordable hotel that is close to USS then this is it!

Breakfast cost was included; has a good variety. Ranging from Japanese, Chinese noodles, Malay nasi lamak to Western bacon, eggs hash browns and cereals. Lots of dessert and drink options too. However if you want to save money and not include the breakfast option, there is a Malaysian Street Food cafe located close to USS (500 meter walk) that has food & drink ranging from $8-15 per person.

Transport between hotel and main island. The hotel has a shuttle bus service that runs every 30mins to and from the hotel and vivocity/habour front MRT (train station).

To get to the hotel, I'd strongly advise visitors to get to the hotel via taxi/grab car.  It's a 500 meter walk from yhe monorail station and there's a 75meter slope to get to the hotel. No problem if you take the shuttle bus or taxi though. 

Cleanliness. There were a few stain marks in the bath tub and the wooden shelves in the bathroom showed signs of water damage (or extended exposure to moisture). The hotel needs to look at the upkeep of the place. 

Lighting. The lifts are quite dark at night and there is insufficient lighting along the corridors. 

General stay at the hotel is comfortable and staff are helpful and friendly. Guests staying on levels 1 and 2 have to check that the room windows are locked otherwise it can be accessed from outside.

title: “The customer service was disappointing. ”
review_text: We did not feel welcomed at all. I don’t know if these front desk officers have gone for relevant training sessions but the one attending to us didn’t even smile and she her body language was rude. Also, smiling is basic for customer service. Furthermore, we called the hotel early in the morning to check if an early check in would be possible and they told us that after 1pm should be good. However, when we reached, the customer service officer told us that we can only check in at 2pm. And in addition to that, she said the $100 deposit has to be by cash or credit card. My partner and I have never faced such an issue before. We were always able to use our debit/masters but fine we asked her where we could withdraw and she said “you can try international plaza but I’m not sure what bank they have.” As a hotel, you should at least know the area around you. So basically we had to wait till 2pm and my partner had to find an ATM himself. So we thought things would get better but the next day at breakfast, it only got worse. The staff working at the restaurant didn’t even know how to approach their guests. The tables were suppose to have cutleries but ours didn’t and so we asked one of the staff and she didn’t speak a word. Not even “sure give me a moment.” She stared and walked off and came back with several knifes and fork and just panicked near the table cause she didn’t get the plates to arrange the cutleries on. When you finish your food, they don’t ask if you’re done or if they may clear it. They just come with their expressionless face, take the plate and walk off. I could go on with this but basically the customer service was disappointing and thus our overall experience wasn’t up to expectations. Doubt I’ll ever go back to this hotel.

title: “Cleaners entered our room from the swimming pool side to use our plug to clean the pool. Absolutely no privacy here with bad service”
review_text:
Check in time 3pm. We checked in earlier at 1pm and came back at 5pm. Was told that the room wasnt ready and theres no estimated time on when the room will be ready.

Asked the reception staff if this is a common practice for rooms to not be ready even hours after check in time. She said "yah its always like that"

They subsequently gave us room key 810 and we were waiting outside for housekeeping to be done. Housekeeper told us to go to room 808 as its already done housekeeping and wonder how come reception didnt give us keys to a room that was ready.

Housekeeper told us she will make the swap and bring room key 808 to us, but she didnt. Instead a couple came through our doors and we told the couple they made a swap and they are at room 810 now.

Massive miscommunication between the staff at this 5star resort.

Room was poorly maintained. We will skip this portion.

Best part was the next day morning, we had cleaners entering our room from the swimming pool side to use the plug to clean the pool. 

This resort is totally ridiculous and there is absolutely no privacy at this resort.

I asked to wait in my uncleaned villa as I thought they are already in the midst of cleaning. To my surprised, there is no cleaning at all and housekeeping only arrived at 530pm.
At 550pm, the housekeeping decided to shift us to another cleaned villa, my friends and I finally settled down at 6ishpm, which totally disrupted their birthday plans for me.
When we started to have our dinner in the villa, we eat in pitch dark, as the lightings were very poor and we have to use our mobile phone flash light throughout the dinner.
The villa is poorly maintained and the service level is poor.
I will not recommend or visit Amara Sanctuary again.
Super bad experienced and poor choice in selecting this resort to spend my birthday.

title: “Poorly maintained ”
review_text:
The hotel was incredibly understaffed and poorly maintained. 

When I checked into the room, there was an eyeliner brush left next to the sink in the bathroom, and the plastic container of a disposable one-time-use eye drop wedged between the bed and the bedside chest of drawers. I decided not to make a fuss of it as I was determined to enjoy my 2-night staycation. 

Then, I realised the toilet wouldn’t flush properly, the tap was leaking, the switch for the pump at the jacuzzi was faulty and the pump went on for 24 hours even though it was meant to stop after 9pm and only starting at 9am. The tv wasn’t working half the time... I do commend the technicians and some of the housekeeping staff for the prompt service though the toilet couldn’t really be fixed. I asked for the glasses/cups in the room to be replaced and they never came. 

I like the hotel but it’s unlikely that I will ever go back for a stay. In fact, I could not wait to check out from the hotel. The hotel needs an overhaul and maybe 50% more staff to make it enjoyable again for guests.

title: “Excellent location - but could do with a few touch-ups”
review_text:
Park royal collection marina bay is located at a very strategic spot in Singapore. It provides accessibility to the marina bay area which further expands into the many touristy areas around Singapore 

My honest opinion after staying here for the third time 

1. Book a club room. It's value for money 
- rebooked 2 club rooms this time around and we totally enjoyed the lounge experience. The afternoon tea was delightful and the evening cocktails were even better. Besides the food and drinks, we also enjoyed the views around the lounge. We were definitely full in our bellies and hearts from the lounge experience. My heartfelt thanks to the lounge team on duty on 23 December. The two of them took care of the busy lounge and make sure that our needs were attended to

2. Check in experience could be better
- the check in is located at the 4th floor. But upon arrival at the check-in time (2.30pm) we realized that the counter for club room check-in privileges was not manned. The whole point of getting the club room was to have a more prestigious entry to the hotel but we ended up waiting for quite some time before we can actually check in through the normal counters. The lady handling our check in could have been friendlier (it always helps to smile) and more helpful (we had to ask her for benefits since we were GHA members instead of being prompted by her).

3. Improvements to the room
- upon checking in, we found a old box of chocolates addressed to the previous guest. Probably this was missed out by housekeeping. We also see that the showers could do with abit of touch up as the shower points showed some signs of mould and rust. The view from our room isn't exactly the best (towards suntec city). Ask for a view towards Esplanade instead.

4. Great architecture
- in our opinion, the best experience wasn't in the room but at the lobby / breakfast area. This hotel integrates nature as part of its whole structure and it was really nice to see some greenery 

We'll still come back since the overall experience was great less a few small area of improvement

review_text:
シンガポールのホテルの中では価格が良心的でアクセスが良かったため宿泊を決めました。駅から徒歩5分もかからず、駅からホテルまでの間に飲食店やコンビニ、スーパーもありました。建物が新しく清潔感もあり、虫やカビなども気になりませんでした。エアコンや温水も問題なく使え、給水器もあり、テレビはYoutube、Netflix、Amazonprimeなどを選べたのでホテル滞在時間が充実していました。清掃も丁寧にしていただけて嬉しかったです。（清掃必要有無は部屋にあるカードで示す形になります）
ホテルに着いてからWiFiが繋がらないハプニングがありましたが、2回ほど機械の電源を入れ直してもらい無事使うことができました。

滞在にあたり、気になったのは部屋の狭さと設備品の簡素さです。部屋はMサイズのキャリーケースですら広げるのがやっとだったので、大きな荷物の方は不向きです。置く場所もほとんどないと思ったほうがいいです。トイレ・バスルーム、ベッドで部屋の8割を占めています。
設備品ですが、タオルはボディタオルとフットタオルのみでフェイスタオルはありません。タオルは使用感があり糸のほつれやごわごわ感があり残念でした。ベッドシーツも破れている箇所があるなど、質の部分は安い値段相応と感じました。ルームウェアもないので持参が必要です。

ホテル滞在時間が少なく、コスパ重視の方にはオススメできるホテルです。

title: “COCKROACH IN MY HOTEL ROOM”
review_text:
My four-night stay was initially quite comfortable until the last night, when I found a cockroach in the room. It was 1:40 a.m., and almost 2 a.m. by the time a staff came. He managed to catch it and explained it was a German roach. I am absolutely terrified of bugs, and did not expect to find a cockroach at a five-star hotel. The staff offered to allow me to move to another room, but as a former travel writer I knew that one roach in one room means that there are more throughout the entire building. It was also past 2 am, and I was extremely tired. I also had a very, very important business meeting the following day. I ended up being unable to sleep that night and feeling very tired for my meeting.

The staff who caught the roach also offered to help with late checkout, but I had already requested it earlier that day. I would have loved to pack everything up and leave first thing in the morning, but I could not do so due to my schedule. I slept very poorly and was very, very tired for my last day of meetings.

During checkout, I called for help with my bags as I had quite a lot, but it took almost one hour for someone to come. I also did not have enough time to complain about the roach situation during checkout because I had another meeting before my late-night flight. The manager apologized about the cockroach and offered a complimentary ride to the airport and a 50% discount on incidentals. My room service bill was around $180, so he offered $90 off. I wanted to argue further that this was not enough, but I did not have time before my last appointment.

title: “Disappointing Stay at Amara Sanctuary – Zero Stars”
review_text:
Our recent stay at Amara Sanctuary was nothing short of frustrating, and if zero stars were an option, that’s what we would give.

We arrived at 2 PM, completed all the paperwork, and went for a walk since check-in was at 3 PM. When we returned at 3:20 PM to collect our room key, the receptionists were chatting among themselves, completely ignoring us. After standing there for 10–15 minutes, I politely asked for an update, only to receive a rude response: “Can you wait for a moment?”—as if I hadn’t already been waiting. After arguing, one of them finally handed over the room key without any apology or explanation about the hotel facilities, WiFi, or anything else.

When we reached our room, we discovered that instead of the king-sized bed we had requested (especially since we had a child with us), we were given a room with two single beds. I immediately called the reception, and they casually said, “We will see what we can do.” Hours passed with no update. I asked again at 6 PM—still no solution. At 8 PM, while heading for dinner, I reminded them again, only to get the same response: “We are looking into it.” I asked to join beds atleast. 

By 10:30 PM, when we returned with our sleepy child, the beds were still not joined. When I asked again, the staff lazily said they would do it “in some time.” At this point, we were exhausted and just wanted to sleep. Finally after a heated arguement they joined beds. sleeping in the middle of two pushed-together beds was extremely uncomfortable.

The next morning, breakfast was another disaster. We arrived at 8 AM to find a long queue, with most food items already finished. There was barely any staff attending to the buffet, and refills were painfully slow. We waited until 9:15 AM, only to be told, “You can take away your food to your room; we don’t have space, and we close at 10.” No apology, no proper service—just pure mismanagement.

Overall, our stay was a complete disappointment. Poor customer service, unhelpful and rude staff, lack of communication, uncomfortable sleeping arrangements, and a terrible breakfast experience. Definitely not worth the price. We won’t be returning and do not recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: “Relaxing getaway”
review_text:
Here is my review of our 4D3N stay at Amara sanctuary 

1. room - decor is very dated, but clean, water pressure is good and come with the basic necessities. A tv that doesnt have any good channels and mostly doesnt work, so i watched tiktok throughout my stay. The cushion for the arm chair is very used, no support at all. But in general, the room is clean and the bed is firm & comfortable. Sound proofing is extremely bad coz im constantly woken up by people talking at the corridor coz there are just some people that dont know how to be more considerate. Was told that i had the sea view room but all i could see out my window are coconut trees. Every morning, there is also a rooster that never fails to wake u up regardless of what time u sleep. There is a snack area where kitkat & oreo are replenish daily, likewise for the drinking water. 
2. Breakfast - very standard n minimal international breakfast. The kuehs are yummy. However, on the last day of my breakfast, i realised the crab stick that i took from the noodle section still has the plastic film/wrapper on and i actually cook that with my noodles without realising, so the kitchen team might wanna do a double check on that. Other than that, service from the staff are always friendly and prompt. 
3. Restaurant - there is an on site restaurant and we had 2 of our dinnners there. Food is great and the service rendered by jennifier is impeccable.  
4. Facilities - a gym and 2 swimming pools. We din check out the gym but the pools were kinda disappointing. The dream pool is for kids so it was rather small. The skypool is also small and not sure if it was due to the rain, the water was murky and doesnt look inviting at all. So we din use the pool during our stay. 

Overall the stay is relaxing and enjoyable. However, there was a little hiccup while checking-in as our reserved rooms [3 rooms, 2 connected rooms with twin beds] werent available even though we were promised that these will be available back when we booked. we specifically requested for twin beds coz our group required that. But, we were given 3 rooms with king sized beds instead. Special thanks to shaz from front desk to do a complimentary upgrade so that we can have 1 room with separate beds. 
Also, special shoutout to the staff uncle liu that drove us to and back from the ultra golf on the buggy, apparently he is the only one licensed to drive out of the hotel area. And the rest of the staff at the hotel, they are all very welcoming and helpful.

First time staying with the Amara Sanctuary with 2 rooms to celebrate our birthday (Yes we are born in the month of May. My wife, 2 teenagers and myself). 
We reach earlier around 10.45am, so we come chill & dine at the poolside like what we usually do at all the hotels we visited.
We walk to the front desk, the were 2 young ladies and a civilian guy at another side of the desk.
We were served by 2 inexperience young girls which inform us that the rooms are not ready which we do understand. 
We wanted to go to the pool to rest and chill while waiting for the rooms. But was told we cannot go to the pool. 
I asked again why was it so? The girls was alittle lost without any help from anyone else. And told us was sort of like their Hotel policy? And the pool needed key access, so we have no choice because we have no room key yet.
We were offered welcome drink vouchers at the cafe? We went to the cafe and while my family enjoy their beverage, I walk around and explore the hotel premises.
oooo... I found the swimming pool but it does not need any card excess? There was 1 or 2 small children's pools and a  small adult pool but with cloudy light green color water? Was not properly maintain I think.
Anyway I walk back to the cafe and told my family there is a pool but not welll maintain. 
I went to the  the lift to see if there are anything else we can visit during our stay. I spotted lvl 4 sky pool? 
Went up to have a look, no need any key access again?
Well, by this time a little upset lol.. maybe the front office was not properly train to handle guess. And maybe there was nobody to help them.
Feeling upset that our pool chill and dine plans are ruined, we decide to visit RWS instead of staying in a boring Hotel.
We just hope that the Amara management may look into all these issues if you would like to have a repeat customers to stay with Amara Sanctuary.
It will be a nice place if the place and staffs are trained and properly maintain.
All the Best

I arrived at the hotel late at night, tired, and the staff greeted me with such joy which made my day!! Third, the room is very clean and cozy. It is indeed small and compact but as I was traveling alone, I loved the size. Also, there is a water purifier on every floor, so it is easy to get water (which is important, considering that water is expensive in the country). I went there to see Taylor Swift and many guests in the hotel were there for the same reason. Because of this, the hotel was playing Taylor's music all day long and it was so nice of them to do. 

After all, I enjoyed staying here and I highly recommend this place!

title: “Feedback on Unprofessional Front Desk Response”

I called [2 Nov at around 6pm] the front desk to clarify whether the drinks in the fridge and tidbits in the coffee drawer were complimentary. The male staff who answered replied, “Yes, but if you want to pay also can.”

When I asked him again what he meant, he said, “All complimentary unless you want to pay — like a donation.”

This response was unprofessional and inappropriate, especially for a hotel rated 5 stars. I was simply seeking clarification and did not expect a sarcastic or dismissive answer. I hope the management will address this and ensure staff maintain a more courteous and professional tone when speaking to guests regardless of their nationality - local or overseas guests.

Great infrastructure, good rooms, good staff, great location - all let down by silly decisions.

Can we sit at a specific table in the restaurant for breakfast? No, that's "reserved for VIPs" (which elsewhere are known as "hotel guests"...).

Can we order breakfast a la carte rather than buffet? No. Then why is there a breakfast menu? OK - here's the menu. Can we order the "light breakfast" (coffee, fruit, toast and pastries) from the menu? No, that's only available as a side order to a main course.

Such small things - but with such a wide (and great) choice of hotels in Singapore, it's enough to be make the choice on.

title: “Major construction  next door ”
review_text:
Overall this hotel was, for Singapore, good value for money. It was very close to Lavender MRT, walking distance to Little India and Kampong Glam, and had good facilities in the area such as a laundromat, atm, supermarket, malls with food places etc across the street. 

The room and the hotel are modern and very clean. The beds were comfortable.  It was a very small room - not big enough for us to unpack or even have space to open our rucksacks properly - but we knew this when booking and alternatives in this price range in Singapore were all the same size or smaller.

Unfortunately the big let down was that there was major construction happening in the adjoining building to the hotel. We sleep with earplugs, and noise doesn’t bother us too much, but the drilling and work that started at 9AM literally shook the entire building. We couldn’t hear each other speak and we were both distressed and I’ll with headache from the noise. We asked to move rooms because our first room was in the worst location for noise. Though it was better in the second room, it was still very loud and we basically avoided being in the room between 9-5AM. Until the construction is finished, I can’t recommend this place for anyone that might want to rest and relax in their hotel room during the day.

The staff seemed apologetic and it’s obviously not something they can control, but unfortunately they don’t advise about it at all and they said it just started the day before we arrived, while the sign on the construction work said it started in September 2023 - 3 months before our stay.

If we hadn’t had a cheap deal on this hotel, we would have asked for our money back and moved hotels, but alternatives on the day were much more expensive than we were willing pay.

Room is very clean and well maintained. Bathroom also clean and does not stink. Walls are also not thin, unlike other hotels in SG with similar price point. AC is also cold, too cold for a small room haha. Bed is perfect and pillows too. Nothing to complain about.

Location is also perfect (if you are bored of staying at Orchard - so basic right). 3 mins walk to Lavender MRT where you could find various F&B places like: Kopitiam, Liho, McD, Old Chang Kee, Jollibean, Hawker center and many more. Across the hotel is a Fair Price, and a stone’s throw away you’ll find alot of new hip cafes like (MILET, La Levain, Chye Huat Hardware, etc) with GOOD pastries. Tried walking and only took 15 mins to Haji Lane, 20 mins to Bugis, and 30 mins to Raffles Place (City Hall MRT)

Receptionist and cleaner were also really friendly and helpful!

Will definitely come back here!

title: “Convenient and Clean”
review_text:
Satisfying stay.

Positive points:
- good location, close to Lavender station, many shops around
- new and clean room, excellent hygiene feel
- shower facility itself is great (temperature, water pressure and shower type)
- bed is fine
- not too crowded
- reception staff genuine, friendly and helpful (way above expectations for this category of hotel in Singapore) - appreciated!

Negative points:
- room A/C is automatically set to 20 degrees, too cold to sleep (only fan or turn off - too hot to sleep)
- there is no shower curtain between the shower and toilet, so the toilet area gets completely wet
- room cleaning was not done on the first day since I did not put the "please clean" sign on the door
- soundproofing is not great
- room is small (compact yet functional, it's okay if you weren't expecting a big room)

This time I found a very good deal, so overall the value for money was justified, and I am happy. Especially refreshing to see all the genuinely kind staff at the hotel, thank you!!

The Premier Marina Bay View Room I reserved had a great view but I wish the balcony had a table and chairs.  
The only problem I had durning my stay was at the 4th floor bar area.  The live music was very good but to get any service from the bar staff was almost impossible.  After 10 minutes of sitting in front of the performers, I was able to get a single glass of wine by flagging down one of the waitress .  After that I was unable to get any service and after 1 hour of waiting I went to the bar to provide my room number for charging of the single glass of wine I received.
I note that I was not the only person that had difficulty in obtaining service that night even though there were at least 4 waitress at the bar.  They made no effort to leve the bar.

The following night on my way back to the  hotel, I stopped at the Marriott’s bar near by for my evening refreshments.

I waited till evening and we decided to head to dinner, thinking that I can order it at their restaurant instead. To our dismay, they do not have cake on their menu, so no cake, no candle blowing. The tv wasn't working in our room and we had 2 technicians sent up to our room to fix it. The kettle was old & stained and the kettle lid couldn't close up properly. We wanted to make some hot drinks but there wasn't any sugar or creamer to go with the coffee/tea. 2 strips of the parquet flooring were loose and kinda 'sink' in whenever we walked on it, causing a slight pinch sensation on our soles and we had to try and walk around it if we remember. Our room was directly above a housekeeping station where they toss used bedsheets and linen into a big blue bin and there was always loud slamming of the bin's door early in the morning, which woke us up. Overall the hotel standard seem to have dropped significantly and our stay was not a pleasant one this time round.

review_text:
