The staff were very helpful and accommodating. 

The room was small but it was okay since we only stayed there to sleep. My suggestion is to pack your stuff in packing cubes (like what we did), in that way you don’t have to leave your luggage open and block the space. 

If you are sensitive to noise while sleeping, I suggest to bring earpiece or something. We can hear other people when they laugh from the other room. We also woke up because we heard their alarm (it’s good that their alarm time was near to ours)

But overall, we will go back to this hotel whenever we’re in Singapore!

title: “Large Pool, Spacious Villa for Four”
review_text:
I understand that it’s a villa, so insects are to be expected, but there was a small cockroach scare in the living room. The pool also had a few bugs floating around by morning. That said, the pool itself was impressively large (& 1.4m deep) for a Sentosa villa, much bigger than the one-bedroom villa at other Sentosa hotels.

One minor inconvenience was that the doorbell wasn’t very audible, so we didn’t hear it ring and were later told by the staff that they had been trying to get our attention. The buggy service was convenient, though it once took around 20 minutes to arrive, by which time we could’ve walked back ourselves if it hadn’t been so dark.

Breakfast was decent, though nothing particularly special. There was no curry available for prata, which felt a bit odd. The indoor carpark was convenient since there was no gantry, but it was quite small like 20 lots. The outdoor carpark had another 10 or so? If there had been a wedding event, there definitely wouldn’t have been enough lots for hotel guests. Fortunately, we were allowed to park in the VIP spaces till there was space in the carpark. 

Spa (Swedish massage) was relaxing, had a 25% off for weekend treatments.

Overall, service was still good, with mostly friendly staff who tried their best to assist whenever possible.

title: “Exceptional”
review_text:
1. The service staff are very good, from the front door receptionist to the check-in counter and all other departments. Upon arrival, I was greeted by a polite receptionist who helped carry my luggage to the room. Although there were a lot of people checking in, I didn’t have to wait too long. I checked in with a female staff member at the check-out counter, and her service was excellent with a clear and easy-to-understand English accent. 
2. The room is as advertised, clean, with a beautiful view of the fountain, Suntec Mall, and the National Stadium from the 17th floor. The view is stunning. The noise from the street isn’t loud, but sometimes at night, loud cars may be heard. I like that there is a hairdryer both in the bathroom and outside, which is very convenient.
3. The hotel is new and clean, located in a great area in the heart of the city, easy to travel to, close to the mall and MRT. The bus stop is not far either. There are several elevators, and you don’t have to wait long. The security system is very good; you can only access the floor you are staying on. The hotel is just as beautiful as in the pictures.

For this stay, I would like to make some recommendations:
1. Breakfast has a variety of options, but mostly only chicken and not much pork. Since I traveled with my grandmother who has gout and doesn’t eat chicken, there were limited food options for us.
2. I stayed in a room that had an adjoining door, and on the second night, the occupants in the adjacent room were talking loudly around midnight, which made it hard to sleep.

Overall, I was very impressed, especially with the service, location, cleanliness, and beauty of the hotel. It’s a pity that I didn’t take many photos of the accommodation during this trip; it really is very beautiful. If I have the opportunity, I will return to stay here again.

title: “Minimal, but clean and quiet in a great location”
review_text:
Room: Just like the photos on their website. No surprises there. I found the deluxe double room to be a comfortable size for a single person, particularly for a long stay (1-2 weeks). It's very clean and new. Quiet, apart from the usual housekeeping sounds, and guests checking-in/out or talking. Window walls, but no view to speak of, and roller shades need to be down for any semblance of privacy.

Location: Exceptional in terms of getting around on foot and by train. Lots of food options (like vegetarian/vegan), even more if you're willing to walk a little farther (head up north too).

Facilities: None, although there is a sports complex (swimming pool and gym) just across the street.

Staff: Professional, courteous, friendly, and efficient. Very smooth check-in/out process. Staff I met included Jes, Christine, and Vissa(?) (apologies for mangling any names). And not forgetting the housekeeping staff too.

Overall, it was a really pleasant stay, and I was able to explore quite a bit. I would definitely book this hotel again.

title: “Luxury stay bogged by tiny imperfections”
review_text:
Overall, hotel location and design gave it a pretty posh and elegant look. Overall things were okay except for some of the minor things that happened:

- Air-condition was down on first day, apparently there was a power trip which was fixed when the technicians were called in
- Air-condition on second night was also not cold, hovered around 25deg even though we set the temperature to the lowest temp available at 10 deg, best to have it serviced regularly
- walls were quite thin, we could hear our neightbours quite clearly, as well as guest who were walking outside our room
- smart tv setup was laggy, there were times when reception was lost and the tv just remained blank
- bathtub taps were loose but technicians helped to fix them
- housekeeping took away all our half used toiletries but did not replace them, had to call and request. also, face and hand towels were not replaced

Quite a pity because I wasn’t really expecting such teeny weeny issues from a luxury hotel.

title: “Stay at the family suite”
review_text:
The staff need to be better informed about the new measures that took place; to be able to advise the guest properly with their queries. 

It is not helpful at all to receive a piece of information from one staff which confirms it, and later, it was then denied due to a different opinion from another team. 

For guests like us, we usually make plans and itineraries for our outings, so these plans were then affected because the staff made changes at the last minute, and few adjustments on the guest part needed to be made. For, e.g. we engaged a party planner when we received confirmation that this could be done. We were told that only 5 people are allowed in the room but later to find out that my neighbour next door has 9 people in it - let's just assumed they are all under 1 same address. But according to the hotel policy as what we were told, only 5 at all times. 

Our room was not clean—our toddler at the stage of mouthing start crawling and pick up the things on the floor. We politely asked for it to be clean again, just a quick sweep and mop. But however, we should assumed that it is clean, considering it has been cleaned twice. It is not; we found a piece of broken glass. Imagine, it would have ended badly if I decided to do with the situation and not clean it for the 3rd time. Beside that, the bin was not clean and had leftover rubbish from the  previous guest. 

At the start, I believe in the standard build by Amara but their cleaning departments brings down the rating and good name of Amara. For the price that we are paying - cleanliness is the least we can ask for and not expecting for a top standard first class service. Just cleaniness. 

We are generally easy, make do with it in the end - even when there's a leakage every single time we shower and had to wipe the floor with our towels each time. 

The phone in the room is not working as well - each time we needed something specified I had to call the reception using my mobile phone. 

There's a facilities

title: “The rooms are clean and good but…”
review_text:
Check in was relatively challenging as the hotel mentioned they were not able to locate my booking. 

They requested for me to check with Agoda instead despite me showing them an email with a confirmed status.  With the confirmed status, Agoda will not cancel nor refund any payment because it was evidently not their fault - but the hotel insisted Agoda was the one who cancelled and asked me to check with Agoda instead. Hotel said they could not do anything for me unless we book via walk in rates.

I mean what is this???? We packed and were waiting for check in - the hotel could at the least arrange for a new reservation with my confirmed email. However the receptionist left it up to us to decide and again emphasized that there’s nothing they can do unless we book via walk in rates.  It was already chaotic  enough as I was trying to handle 2 active kids and we were stuck at the lobby for 1 full hour (with them still insisting that I should call Agoda). True enough I called Agoda and Agoda insisted it’s a confirmed reservation and they would like us to check with the hotel again. This back and forth caused a lot of  stress and anxiety - we booked the hotel because we had a wedding to attend to later in the evening. 

End up the hotel checked and checked and said there was some issue with the interface and there was my booking but it’s just that it did not surface until they did an in depth check.  I mean obviously it couldn’t be our fault right?

I don’t know if it was really the case because either way they could have just done a new reservation in the meantime and alleviate the anxiety from guests…

But ok the rooms are spacious and comfortable. No complains for the stay except for the check in.

title: “Luggage storage or early check-in, etc..!”
review_text:
It was difficult to find the entrance to the mall since I couldn't go to the hotel lobby during the F1 period, but this is a special situation, so it's fine..! Once you enter the lobby, the staff immediately takes your luggage and gives you a storage card. You can comfortably leave your luggage and go to the lobby to check in. I arrived one or two hours earlier than the 3 PM check-in, but they gave me the key right away..! I was exhausted from the unexpectedly hot Singapore, but I took a comfortable break before heading out for dinner.

The hotel lobby is beautiful and grand, and I enjoyed a very hearty breakfast every day in front of the lobby.

It was nice that I could take a break at the café on the opposite side without ordering separate drinks, and the staff continuously moved my luggage to the lobby, making it very convenient. There were plenty of elevators compared to the number of rooms, and they were fast, so I hardly had to wait.

The pool is great for relaxing during the day, but it is really beautiful at night! Even if you don't swim, I recommend you go at night, take some photos, and have a cocktail at the bar next door.

I don't speak English, but they explained everything slowly, so I didn't feel uncomfortable even when I had questions.~
